characters.name: Clover Kingdom in General
characters.description: Crapsaccharine World: Clover Kingdom is certainly beautiful, prosperous and peaceful, having drawn many peasants from the Forsaken Region to visit the Royal Capital where they either join the Magic Knights and/or settle there. At least until they find out its dark side in form of the royals and nobles abusing them and also the commoners who live with them. Create Your Own Hero: Despite the crappy state of Clover Kingdom, it motivates peasants like Asta and Yuno to fight and work their way to the top as the strongest members of the Magic Knights with the ambition to become Wizard King and the belief that Clover Kingdom can change for the better with their actions as an example to follow. Create Your Own Villain: Unfortunately due to itsCrapsaccharine Worldstatus, it creates powerful enemies who become threats to the Clover Kingdom such as the Eye of the Midnight Sun, the Devil Banishers/Believers andthe previous Wizard Kings: Conrad Leto, Princia Funnybunny, Jester Garandros and Edward Avalache. Fantastic Caste System: The people of Clover Kingdom are divided into three classes: peasant, commoner, and noble/royal. The nobles & royals are the highest class among them due to their great amounts of mana, and wealth and status, while the commoner is the middle class and the peasants are the lowest, both of them are in a state of poverty. The latter two end up being the subject of prejudice by the royals/nobles even if they have large mana reserves of their own. Meanwhile, not even nobles and royals are safe as they discriminate each other based on their wealth and status, and their level of mana and magic skill.They even go as far as plotting to discredit and kill Wizard Kings who wanted to undo the status quo with their reforms. Fantastic Racism: Downplayed. On the other hand, the people of Clover Kingdom never likes outsiders such as Yami Sukehiro when he first arrived on their shoresafter fleeing from the Land of the Sunand it is the reason why Fanzell Kruger and Domi

characters.name: In General
characters.description: A trio of siblings from Zogratis family, who overthrew House Grinberryall and took over the Spade Kingdom. They're in league with the Supreme Devils and each of them is a host to one with three strongest devils. 0% Approval Rating: For their lower class citizens at least, who are used as living mana fuel for the kingdom's fortresses and mistreated by the military. Arch-Enemy: All three were set up as this for the main trio:Dante was built up as this for Asta after endangering his squad to the point that Asta becomes even more demonic in his Black Form out of rage. Not to mention that his biological mother's death is connected to Lucifero, Dante's devil, and Dante desires to fight Asta again... which ends upnever happening; Magna beats him down before Asta ever arrives for a rematch, and Jack appears to finish him off.So much for that.While Megicula is Noelle's overall archenemy for cursing her mother Acier to death, she holds Vanica in a similar disdain for kick-starting a fight that led to Acier's death. Her hatred is only aggravated when Vanica takes Lolopechka hostage instead of killing her in hopes that Noelle gets even stronger for Vanica to have a powerful opponent when they fight again. And Vanica getsexactly what she wished forwhen Noelle easily defeats her with her new Saint Stage form, before she gets to confront Megicula.Zenon's was Yuno's due to not only taking part in killing Yuno's parents, the former rulers of the Spade Kingdom, but also capturing Vangeance and killing half of the Golden Dawn. When Yuno fights him again, he tells Zenon that he'lldiehaving regretted touching the Golden Dawn. Dante was built up as this for Asta after endangering his squad to the point that Asta becomes even more demonic in his Black Form out of rage. Not to mention that his biological mother's death is connected to Lucifero, Dante's devil, and Dante desires to fight Asta again... which ends upnever happening; Magna beats him down before Asta ever arrives for a rematch,

characters.name: Charlotte Roselei
characters.description: A woman who dislikes men, leading the Blue Rose Knights to become a mostly female faction. Always looking calm and collected, Charlotte harbors a secret crush on Yami, causing her to completely lose her focus when she's around him.Uses Briar Magic, which transforms her sword into a rose bush she can manipulate at will. Affectionate Nickname: Sol refers to Charlotte as "Sis", much to the latter's chagrin. In the English dub, it's "Char". All Amazons Want Hercules: Believed in this, thinking that no suitor who could defeatherwould be strong enough to accept her curse. Fittingly, she fell in love with Yami when he saved her from her curse and told her that he liked tough girls like her, but even then, she could count on others for help and not shoulder her burdens alone. Anguished Declaration of Love:She finally confesses her love for Yami as he lies mortally wounded after the fight with Lucifero. After Yami regains consciousness, Charlotte is mortified when he vaguely recalls her saying something. Battle Ballgown: HerTrue Briar Magic: Queen of Briars forms a dress out of thorns and roses that increases the power of her magic.

characters.name: Sol Marron
characters.description: An upbeat woman who has a strong distaste for men. Sol's entirely devoted to her captain and is really friendly with other women.She uses Earth Magic, often creating golems out of dirt and riding them into battle. Ambiguously Brown: The only dark-skinned character in the setting, other than an unnamed Shining General of the Diamond Kingdom. Ambiguously Gay:Her very strong feelings for Charlotte can easily be seen as romantic. She even has aNosebleedwhen she sees Charlotte naked. She is also very enthusiastic about washing Noelle's back in the hot springs. Awesome, but Impractical: Kirsh declares her golem this. It is powerful, but also a colossal target for their opponents. Bare Midriffs Are Feminine: Herrevealing outfitconstantly leaves her stomach exposed and is the only one who does so in the Blue Rose Knights.

characters.name: Puli Angel
characters.description: Acrofatic: Despite being pretty plump, she moves quite fast through the air with her Wing Magic. Big Fun: She's on the rounder side but nevertheless an enthusiastic woman, even when working alongside teammates she doesn't like. Combination Attack: Her Lightning Arrow spell with the rest of Team K during the Royal Knights Exam, creating a large arrow made of electricity that's fitted onto a railgun which is flown with wings. Dreadful Musician: She sings an inspiring song before the Royal Knights set off, and it's all over for the Knights' eardrums. Feather Flechettes: She can fire many feathers from her magical wings.

characters.name: Borja
characters.description: Flat Character: Not much is known about her other than she's a member of the Blue Rose Knights.

characters.name: Wainsley
characters.description: Blue Means Cold: She's an ice mage dressed in blue clothes. An Ice Person: She uses Ice Magic to form spiked ice.

characters.name: Risacca Ondell
characters.description: Elemental Eye Colors: She has blue eyes and she uses Water Magic. Making a Splash: She uses Water Magic to form waves. Meaningful Name: Risacca is Italian for "undertow" or "backwash", which is a reference of her magic. Sharing a Body: Turns out to be sharing the body with the soul of a long-dead elf.

characters.name: Jack the Ripper
characters.description: A gaunt man who always keeps a sharp smile on his face, and wants to slice up powerful foes. His patience is very limited.Uses Severing Magic to summon blades of mana on his forearms. Described as able to cut through any material, Jack can also launch these blades as projectiles. Absurdly Sharp Blade: His magic conjures up two huge blades growing from his forearms. Blades that alter themselves on contact with an enemy's magic, meaning that they can counter any magical defense and cut through anything. Nor is he limited to cutting through physical objects, as showing when heovercomes Dante's Gravity Magic by forming blades thatcut through gravity. Adaptive Ability: His Severing Magic is this, changing the blades' nature and sharpness to whatever he's trying to cut up, allowing it to slice through Latry's Spatial Magic. As he fights Fana his blades adapt to sever her regeneration. Animal Battle Aura: Is seen as a giant praying mantis toDantewhen fighting him alongside Nacht. Animal Motifs: Mantis. He leads a squad known as the Green Praying Mantises and his magic forms blades of mana on his forearms.

characters.name: Sekke Bronzazza
characters.description: An opportunistic jerkass who attempts to join the Magic Knights by making Asta look bad. After being put in his place, he outgrows a touch of the jerk and becomes a washed-up loser and hopeless womanizing gambler.Uses Bronze Magic, using Bronze to manipulate and create objects. Can notably grant them a poisonous side-effect. Affectionate Nickname: Asta calls him "Bah-hah" after his laugh. Agony of the Feet: A bandit stabbed him through his boot and sock with a poisoned knife after being run over. It wasn't as bad as it appeared to be and Sekke overreacted. Animal Motifs: Insects, given his squad and the fact that he is one of the weakest recurring characters in the story. In terms of power andcharacter. Barrier Warrior: His signature magic is a spherical shield adorned with spiked protrusions resembling cannons.So far, he's never gotten the chance to show what it does besides block attacks.

characters.name: En Ringard
characters.description: En's sickly appearance is a facade for a surprisingly determined and energetic Magic Knight. He'll always protect his teammates, whatever the cost.En uses Fungus Magic. This branch of magic creates sentient, talking mushrooms with cartoonish faces, which can inflict a variety of ailments or protect their creator and his friends. Big Brother Instinct: He believes that protecting one's younger siblings is the duty of the elder sibling and for this reason he scorns Solid for doing the opposite. He himself has ten younger siblings. Blood Knight: Noelle notes that he is far more energetic during battle, at least when speaking through his mushrooms. Creepy Good: He has this lanky and grungy look to him, speaks in something of a monotone andgrows mushrooms on peoplebut turns out to be a nice guy and protective brother figure. Curtains Match the Windows: Green hair and green eyes.

characters.name: Willy
characters.description: Covered in Mud: He uses Mud Magic to form a small bog that clings to enemies. Inconsistent Spelling: Three different ways by official sources. He's called Winry by Viz, Willie by the sub, and Willy by the dub. Quicksand Sucks: His Mud Magic forms a big that acts as this.

characters.name: Nix
characters.description: Anime Hair: His brown hair is styled in spikes that stick up. Elemental Weapon: He uses his Flame Magic to form a flail. Epic Flail: His Flame Spike spell forms a spiked flail out of fire. Playing with Fire: He uses Flame Magic to form a spiked orb out of fire.

characters.name: Rill Boismortier
characters.description: The Captain of the Aqua Deer. An eccentric young boy whose great magic powers allowed him to quickly climb the ranks towards captain at the age of 19, making him the youngest Magic Knight captain.Uses Picture Magic, capable of creating anything by making a painting of it. As a result, Rill stands amongst the very few mages capable of wielding several types of elemental magic. Amazon Chaser: He falls in love withCharmy after she defeated him in a fight. Anime Hair: His hair is unusually spiked and also unusually shaped, looking like a pine tree. Art Attacker: He has Picture Magic, turning his paintings into attacks. The more inspired he is the more powerful spells he can paint. Attack Reflector: His spell Game of the Gods paints a beaded deity who sends back spells fired at him. He was inspired to make this spell after seeing Zora fight.

characters.name: Cob Portaport
characters.description: Meaningful Name: His last name comes from the French phrase "porte-à-porte" which means door-to-door, perfectly describing his Spatial Magic. Nice Guy: He's shown to be a nice, polite guy who's helpful with his magic. One Degree of Separation: He served alongside Marx, Yami and Vangeance back when Julius was captain of the Grey Deers. Space Master: He uses Spatial Magic to create doorways that serve as portals. He's specifically chosen to join the Royal Knights because of his magic's usefulness. Sharing a Body: Is possessed by a soul of an elf named Ado.

characters.name: Fragil Tormenta
characters.description: A discreet Magic Knight, Fragil tries to get along with her teammates and keep their quirky personalities in check.Able to cast Snow Magic spells, numbing her enemies' senses and draining their energy. Astonishingly Appropriate Appearance: She wears a furry white hat and white robes, and uses Snow Magic. Elemental Eye Colors: She has blue gray eyes and uses Snow Magic. Elemental Motifs: Snow, befitting an elegantSnow magethat specializes inhealing. Healing Hands: She can use her Snow Magic to heal others.

characters.name: Morgen Faust
characters.description: Nacht's younger twin brother and a former member of the Aqua Deer, back when it was Grey Deer. Back from the Dead: He was revived by Lucius Zogratis using his Soul magic and his sibling’s Body, Blood and Bone magic to create a new body for him, while brainwashing him into being his supporter. Big Brother Worship: Loved his older twin brother and praised Nacht for his talent for magic, trying to get him to join the Magic Knights. As he dies, he tells Nacht that his dream was for them to protect the kingdom together as knights of shadow and light. Black Sheep: Was this for the House of Faust, being an upright Magic Knight while his family was devoted to studying devils. Elemental Motifs: Light, in line withhis magic, on top ofembodying many of its positive qualities. He is a warm, selfless individual beloved by many and acts as aPositive Friend Influenceon even the likes ofYamiandhis brother Nacht.

characters.name: Cesc
characters.description: Attack Animal: He uses his Shakudo Magic to form jackals that pursue and attack Magna. Dub Name Change: An egregious one for his magic. VIZ calls it Bronze Magic, in the sub it's called Shakudo Magic (the literal translation), and in the dub it's called Copper Magic. Elemental Hair Colors: He has red hair, the same color of his Shakudo Magic. Extra-ore-dinary: He uses Shakudo Magic.

characters.name: Francis
characters.description: A member of the Aqua Deer. Making a Splash: He uses Water Magic to cast a blast and barrier of water. Water Is Blue: He wears a dark blue robe and uses Water Magic.

characters.name: Eric
characters.description: A member of the Aqua Deer. Flat Character: Not much is known about him other than he's a member of the Aqua Deer.

characters.name: Dorothy Unsworth
characters.description: The captain of the Coral Peacocks. A woman who spends all her time asleep. Her feats are a mystery to many and some wonder how she became a Magic Knight. When awake, she has a surprisingly bright and playful personality.Her magic is Dream Magic, allowing her to pull victims into a dream-like world which creates anything that she imagines. Animal Motifs: Reve uses a tapir to attack the Black Bulls while controlling Dorothy's body, and Dorothy is depicted with a giant tapir on the cover page of Chapter 222, which is fitting for her powers over dreams and cute appearance. Big Sleep: Enemies who stay in her Glamour World become more drowsy, and die if they fall asleep. Brilliant, but Lazy: Due to being asleep almost all the time, her Vice Captain Kirsch essentially takes up all her duties. Despite this, when awake she proves herself to be a powerful mage with her Dream Magic, trapping enemies in her Glamour World where she imagines anything that she thinks about. Bunny-Ears Lawyer: She's weird and spends most of her time asleep, and even when she's awake she has areallyplayful and energetic personality, but she can back that Captain title up with her extremely powerful Dream Magic.

characters.name: Kirsch Vermillion
characters.description: The vice-captain of the Coral Peacocks. The brother of Mimosa Vermillion, he's a shallow man obsessed with beauty. As such, he has a huge hatred of commoners, or more accurately, of anybody and anything that is not up to par with his standards. His skills, though, are undisputed, and his magical insight is his best asset.He uses Cherry Blossom Magic, manipulating huge amounts of cherry blossom petals to create clones, obfuscate enemies and conjure up whole blizzards. Agent Peacock: His strength in battle is directly proportional to his flamboyance. Annoying Younger Sibling: Inverted. He is Mimosa's annoying older brother, and she is mortified by his flamboyance. Awesomeness by Analysis: He analyzes Magna and Sol's battle techniques and comes up with ways to improve them in a couple of minutes. Awesome, but Impractical: His magic creates flower petals, which is fancy and flamboyant - and creates a mess around him when they gather on the floor. Mimosa had to clean them up, and she actually getspissedat him when the subject comes up.

characters.name: Rick Cornell
characters.description: A Third Class Intermediate Magic Knight who uses Mineral Magic. Aura Vision: His Crystal Scope detects the physical state of anyone it looks at. Combination Attack: Curtis uses his Strong Bow to fire Forti's Burst Javelins at Team B's crystal, with Rick scoping them with his Crystal Scope. Did Not See That Coming: He's quite surprised when Asta blocks his teammates' combo spells and charged at them with their own crystal. Gemstone Assault: He uses Mineral Magic to form a helmet scope and giant blade.

characters.name: Dmitri Blint
characters.description: Afro Asskicker: A competent Magic Knight who has an orange afro. Curtains Match the Windows: Orange eyes and hair. Elemental Eye Colors: Orange eyes and uses Flame Magic. Elemental Hair Colors: His hair is an orange afro and he uses Flame Magic. Fireballs: His spell Combo Eruption unleashed a series of explosive fireballs.

characters.name: Roland
characters.description: Elemental Hair Colors: At first, he is seen with grey-green hair and uses Plant Magic. Green Thumb: He uses Plant Magic to bind opponents in vines. Inconsistent Coloring: His hair is initially depicted in the anime as a grayish green, but is later dark blonde when possessed by an elf. Sharing a Body: He has a soul of an elf. Status Buff: He uses Plant Reinforcement Magic to cast the spell Magic Pollen, which releases pollen that increases allies' magic power.

characters.name: Medio
characters.description: A member of the Coral Peacocks. Delinquent Hair: He has a dyed red mohawk atop his short black hair. Instant Runes: His Trap Magic forms magic circles mid-air. Trap Master: He uses Trap Magic. They don't slow Langris at all though.

characters.name: Protobe Collina
characters.description: Dishing Out Dirt: He uses Earth Magic to form a large wall from the ground. Elemental Hair Colors: He has dark blonde hair and uses Earth Magic. Meaningful Name: Protobe is Latin for hill, and he used Earth Magic. Sharing a Body: He has a soul of an elf.

characters.name: Gueldre Poizot
characters.description: The former captain of the Purple Orcas. A con man and morally dubious individual.Wielder of Transparency Magic, which renders Gueldre invisible and intangible. Can also create faceless invisible mooks. Ambition Is Evil: Gueldre craves having a high social status, which led to him doing shady business in order to rise through the ranks of the Magic Knights. Animal Motifs: Pigs, befitting a greedyFat Bastardwho is willing to sell out his own country to make extra money. Back for the Dead:He and Revchi show up for the first time since the Elf Invasion arc during the battle against Lucius... only for the latter to promptly kill them off and steal their magics. Eventually subverted when Julius rewinds the kingdom back to its original state, bringing all the dead back to life. Bad Boss: He's apparently willing to attack his own knights for money. He's also responsible for driving Revchi into becoming a thief by purposefully setting him up to fail and possibly banishing Rades over his Wraith Magic.

characters.name: Kaiser Granvorka
characters.description: All There in the Manual: He is unnamed in the manga so far, but the official guidebook says that his name's Kaiser Granvorka. Blow You Away: Has Vortex Magic that allows him to create a wind vortex that can blow away spells and mana. Graceful Loser: He does not appear angry at all when hearing that his squad is second-to-last in the rankings. Happily Married: The Q&A in Volume 18 reveals that he has a wife, who he says soothes his heart. The anime shows her in a cameo after he's possessed. Hyper-Competent Sidekick: As a member of the Purple Orcas he was about ten times as capable and worthier thanbothGueldrePoizotand the former Vice-Captain and as the new captain he's amajorcase ofRedeeming Replacement. Worthy of notice, and as seen inBlack Clover: Sword of the Wizard King, is the fact that whenConradLetofirst attacked The Clover Kingdom years before, it wasKaiserwho fought alongside the other Magic Captains, not Gueldre Poizot.

characters.name: Xerx Lugner
characters.description: Asshole Victim: Considering he tries to kill a worried grandmother to "put her out of her suffering", he deserves his brutal defeat at Zora's hands. Blue Means Cold: He has blue eyes and wears a blue cape, and is an ice mage famed as the Saint of Pure Ice. Dressing as the Enemy: Xerx is on the receiving end of this by Zora who simply took his Purple Orca robes and pass himself off as him. It didn't help that due to Xerx being stationed at the Clover Kingdom's border, none of the Magic Knights knew what he really looked like, which Zora took advantage of it. Jerkass: A rather unreasonable one. When an old woman asked him to help her find her granddaughter (who he had kidnapped in the first place), Xerx instead offered to use his magic tokill the old woman so that he might end her suffering. Unfortunately for him, Zora intervened and took him down while taking his Purple Orcas robe for the Royal Knights Exam. An Ice Person: He uses Ice Magic to form sharp spikes.

characters.name: Zara Ideale
characters.description: The first peasant to become a Magic Knight and the father of Zora Ideale. Action Dad: He was a father when he became the first peasant Magic Knight. Deceased Parents Are the Best: He was shown to be a loving father to Zora, and was killed by his squadmates for being a peasant. Determinator: Despite failing the Magic Knights Entrance Exam repeatedly since he was 15, he continued to take it until he passed at the age of 30. Elemental Hair Colors: He had dark red hair and used Flame Trap Magic.

characters.name: Adrian
characters.description: Elemental Eye Colors: Blue eyes and uses Water Magic. Making a Splash: He uses Water Magic to form a coelacanth out of water.

characters.name: Gaston
characters.description: Flat Character: Not much is known about him other than he's a member of the Purple Orcas.

characters.name: Winston
characters.description: Adaptational Badass: Heavily downplayed. In the manga, he tries to throw a huge spiky rock that Klaus easily dispatches at close range. In the anime's Opening 6, he gets to show off his magic by meteor summoning he rides on it to crash land into the ground and blow away the Water Magic's area of effect but then he gets taken down by a blitzing Klaus. Colony Drop: His magic appears to be summoning a meteor from space, which he rides on it with style as shown in Opening 6 of the anime. After landing, he throws the meteor at the enemy. Flat Character: Not much is known about him other than he's a member of the Purple Orcas with hot-blooded passion. Hot-Blooded: He's very enthusiastic about the Royal Knights Exam, so much that Mimosa tries to calm him down and he apologizes for it. Super-Strength: He is able to lift up a meteor that he summoned with his magic singlehandedly before throwing it towards the enemy. However he was too slow to do it as Klaus strikes him down quickly.

characters.name: Digit Taliss
characters.description: Elemental Hair Colors: He has dark purple hair and uses Poison Plant Magic. Elemental Motifs: Poisonous plants. Despite being a member of the typically sketchy Purple Orca's squad, he is a rather kind person, his preferred use of his magic to find cures. Green Thumb: He uses Poison Plant Magic to form giant poisonous plants with skewering vines. Meaningful Name: His name is split from digitalis which are a type of poisonous plants. Mirror Character: He is basically the Purple Orcas' equivalent to Gordon. Both are people withpoison based powers, but areactually goodand anxious people.

characters.name: Marx Francois
characters.description: Beleaguered Assistant: Says that being an attendant of the Wizard King makes his life hellish. Heart Is an Awesome Power: Although his Memory Magic isn't overtly strong, at the hands of an elf, it can be used to create a magical crossbow which fires bolts that erase people's short-term memories, showing the power an elf has in anyone they can possess. Laser-Guided Amnesia: While controlled by an elf, his magic can fire magical bolts from a crossbow that erase short-term memories. Sharing a Body: Shares his with an elf. Telepathy: He can use his Memory Magic to read minds.

characters.name: Owen
characters.description: Animal Motifs: His Magic forms healing jellyfish. He's also a very docile person. Healing Hands: Justified since he's a healer, and reputed to be the best in the kingdom. Heal It with Water: He uses Water Magic to form a magical jellyfish that heals wounds. Heart Is an Awesome Power: Although his magic is far from useless due to its healing ability, at the hands of an elf, it can form a gigantic jellyfish that gives Yami trouble, showing the power an elf has in anyone they possess. Making a Splash: He uses Water Magic to heal others by forming jellyfish.

characters.name: Orsi Orfai
characters.description: Adaptation Expansion: In the anime, he and the other residents of Hage are shown more after the events of Chapter 1. He's shown to be greatly surprised that Asta's made it into a Magic Knights squad. Adaptational Jerkass: Though he's still rather nice, he's shown to have little faith in Asta more often in the anime:In Episode 7, he automatically assumes Asta failed the Magic Knight exam and is already suggesting a party to cheer him up when he gets back. He is completely shocked that Asta managed to get in.In Episode 30, he's proud that Yuno was able to get promoted while assuming that Asta is most likely being a burden to others. He's then shocked again when he finds out that Asta has been promoted as well. In Episode 7, he automatically assumes Asta failed the Magic Knight exam and is already suggesting a party to cheer him up when he gets back. He is completely shocked that Asta managed to get in. In Episode 30, he's proud that Yuno was able to get promoted while assuming that Asta is most likely being a burden to others. He's then shocked again when he finds out that Asta has been promoted as well. All There in the Manual: His full name's shown only in his character profile in one of the volumes.

characters.name: Lily Aquaria
characters.description: The nun whom Asta is enamored with, and a pupil of Sister Theresa Rapual.She's a non-violent practitioner of Water Magic. Adaptation Expansion: Shown more often in the anime and is even given a role in a filler arc. Angelic Abomination:Turns into one in Chapter 334 after being affected by Lucius's Soul Magic. Apologetic Attacker:Played for laughs with Asta. He repeatedly begs her to marry him until she has enough and hits him with her Water Magic to get him to stop pestering her. She immediately feels guilty for it and apologies. Apparently, this was a common occurrence between them as Asta was growing up.A much more dramatic example comes later:Lily doesn'twantto kill Asta, but Julius has turned her into anAngelic Abominationthatmust follow his orders for the greater good, which means eliminating Asta as "the Flaw in the world." Cue Sister Lily emotionally breaking down, sobbing hysterically even as she uses her magic to try and murder Asta. Played for laughs with Asta. He repeatedly begs her to marry him until she has enough and hits him with her Water Magic to get him to stop pestering her. She immediately feels guilty for it and apologies. Apparently, this was a common occurrence between them as Asta was growing up.

characters.name: Nash
characters.description: Adaptation Expansion: In the anime, it's explicitly shown that he hasn't any hope about Asta because he, Asta, and the others are poor and thus can't have dreams, unlike the wealthy. All There in the Manual: His name wasn't revealed in any of the chapters, but the character information provided in the volumes listed his name and the other orphans'. Only in Chapter 158 was his name revealed in a chapter at last. Deadpan Snarker: As shown when all he has to say in response to Asta's not getting a grimoire is "Are you kidding me?" with a blank stare. Elemental Motifs: Fire, matching his magic and his drive after being inspired by Asta towork hardto become a Magic Knight. Jerk with a Heart of Gold: He's incredibly snide and bratty toward Asta. However, when Asta manages to become a Magic Knight, he is shown to be happy that Asta was successful.

characters.name: Drouot
characters.description: All There in the Manual: His true name's revealed in the official guidebook. Eyes Always Shut: Generally, keeps his eyes closed, but opens them once when assuring people that, yes, someone among them wants to become the next Wizard King. Hidden Depths: Despite telling Sister Lily and the priest that he doesn't know whether Asta's book is a grimoire, he seems to be one of the few characters who see that Asta's grimoire is no ordinary one. Robe and Wizard Hat: Looks like the traditional old wizard. Wizard Beard: His age and vocation as the keeper of grimoire is reflected in his long and white beard.

characters.name: Rebecca Scarlet
characters.description: Adaptational Early Appearance: She appears much earlier in the anime with her younger siblings. Blonde, Brunette, Redhead: Formed by her and her two friends during their mixer with Asta, Finral, and Luck. Commonality Connection: Bonds with Asta over their shared experiences taking care of their younger brothers and sisters. Feminine Women Can Cook: She cooks for a restaurant. Asta enjoys her food so much he tells her she'd be a great wife. Noelle grudgingly admits her food is delicious. Massive Numbered Siblings: Five younger siblings - three brothers, two sisters.

characters.name: Theresa Rapual
characters.description: A nun who works at the church in the town of Nean and former Magic Knight.She's a master of defensive Flame Magic, able to heal others. Animal Motifs: Leopards. She's known as the Crimson She-Leopard and can form a living leopard out of her Flame Magic. Badass Teacher: She used to be Fuegoleon and Mereoleona's magic instructor and still is shown to be able to stop the two from coming to blows with just her hands and her presence even though they are two of the most powerful mages in the Clover Kingdom. Combat Medic: She can use her Flame Magic as a defensive shield, but she mostly uses it to heal others. Cool Old Lady: Was a renowned Magic Knight before retiring to become a nun and look after children. She even taughtMereleona and Fuegoleonin the past, her scolding being enough to get both to stop fighting.

characters.name: Marie Adlai
characters.description: Gauche's beloved little sister. She lives in a church in Nean. She's an innocent, kind, and caring girl who loves her big brother and takes a liking to Asta. Body Motifs: Eyes, matchingher magicand being aCheerful Childeveryone finds adorable to look at. Cheerful Child: Marie is a very upbeat little girl despite her tragic life. The Cutie: A cute and friendly girl, she is doted on by many and is especially seen as such especially by her adoring brother. Damsel in Distress: She's tried by the Magic Parliament for Eclat's actions while she possessed her body and about to be executed before Asta saves her.

characters.name: Augustus Kira Clover XIII
characters.description: The king of the Clover Kingdom, and its actual ruler. A pompous braggart who loves being adored, but is completely overshadowed by the far more competent and charismatic Wizard King. This makes him very jealous of Julius, and he takes every opportunity to try and hog the spotlight for himself. His actual subjects all privately prefer Julius over their actual king any day. 0% Approval Rating: He's not hated per se, but his subjects have all thought that they would prefer Julius as their king. It says something when even children can say plainly that Julius the Wizard King should be theactualking when they see him. Even the Magic Knight Captains (the majority of which are of nobility) make it clear they only respect his position as king,notAugustus himself. His lack of talent is not helped by his personality. Always Someone Better: Julius is this to him. Augustus has the title; Julius has the intelligence, charisma, leadership skills and public approval expected from a king. Assassination Attempt: He was almost on the receiving end of this by anti-monarchist nobles who ambushed him and Sekke Bronzazza with intent to make it look like the Eye of the Midnight Sun had assassinated the king.Damnatio Kira steps in to thwart their attempt with Scale Magic. Authority in Name Only: He may be the king of Clover Kingdom, but no one takes him seriously even when he tries to invoke his royal authority.

characters.name: Salim de Hapshass
characters.description: A noble of the Hapshass family whom Yuno beats with ease in the Magic Knights Entrance Exam. Adaptation Expansion: His magic is never shown in the manga, but the anime has him use lightning magic. Adaptational Jerkass: He is just an arrogant noble in the manga, but in the anime, he also reveals himself to be pretty vengeful and remorseless, as he tries to attack Yuno even after being given a chance to be free as long as he never returns to Hage. Adaptational Villainy: In Episodes 12 and 13, he schemes to take Yuno's grimoire, angry that he made him unable to join the Magic Knights. The filler episodes also make him the son of a congressman who turns out to be corrupt, and Salim's testimony apparently exposes his father's wrongdoings. Salim, even if he isn't involved with his father's corruption, probably is punished in some way for his scheme to take Yuno's grimoire. Curb-Stomp Battle: Defeated very quickly by Yuno.

characters.name: Tetia
characters.description: Blow You Away: She uses Wind Magic. Bridal Carry: Licht carried her like that when he saved her from her tornado, which set the path to herbecominghis bride. Death Is Cheap: At her wedding, someone using Light Magic attacked the elves and killed her along with everyone who attended the ceremony.It's revealed much later she was healed by Nero. Her Heart Will Go On: Her husband and his tribe were killed by her fellow royals at her wedding, which led to the death of one of her unborn children and her to be grievously injured.In spite of this, after being healed by Nero Tetia went on to raise her surviving twin child, whose descendants would establish an elf village in the Heart Kingdom. Identical Ancestor:Tetia's female descendant through her and Licht's surviving twin child heavily resembles her as well as Mimosa, her distant niece.

characters.name: Ledior Vaude
characters.description: Abusive Parents: Of the emotional kind. He derided Finral for being unable to use offensive Spatial Magic, comparing him to Langris and eventually disowning him. Parental Favoritism: He favors his younger son Langris over Finral for his stronger magic. Flashbacks show that he would scold Finral for not having Langris's aggressive magic. Space Master: He uses Spatial Magic like the rest of the House of Vaude.

characters.name: Liliane Vaude
characters.description: Parental Favoritism: She favors her son Langris over her stepson Finral. She outright told Finral that she only loves Langris because he isn't her child. Prim and Proper Bun: As a stuffy noblewoman, she wears her hair pined back in a bun. Wicked Stepmother: She treated Finral like garbage, trying to push him as far away from her family as possible because Finral wasn't her child. Combined with his father's discrimination against those with "weak" magic common in high society in the Clover Kingdom, Finral's confidence was completely destroyed, and he was disowned for being seen as worthless. Even when he saves their lives from a possessed Langris, his stepmother is anUngrateful Bitch.

characters.name: Finnes Calmreich
characters.description: A royal woman betrothed to the next head of House Vaude. She is King Augustus's great-niece. Arranged Marriage: Arranged to be married to Langris. She was originally supposed to marry Finral, but he was disowned by his family. Finral declares his intention to fight for her hand after the elves are defeated. She's very happy when she hears this. Birds of a Feather: Both her and Finral are very kind and humble people who do not have high opinions of themselves. When they first met, they were almost instantly attracted to each other. First Love: She's Finral's. She loves him back, and they've both held onto these feelings even after the years when Finral was disowned. Inconsistent Spelling: Her first name can be rendered either as "Finnes" or "Finesse". The official translation uses the former.

characters.name: Damnatio Kira
characters.description: A royal of the House Kira, one of the royal families of the Clover Kingdom along with related to the King. He's the Chairman of the Clover Kingdom's Magic Parliament. And I Must Scream: After the 1-yearTime Skipbetween the Spade Kingdom Raid and the finale,he's reported missing by Fuegoleon, but the chapter before the timeskip shows him frozen in time by Lucius. That's right. At the end he's frozen alive fora full year. Though Chapter 336 implies somethingmuchworse has happened to him. Black-and-White Morality: Subverted in that this piece of work's sense of justice is very biased. He stated at Asta's trial that there were two options regarding the outcome of the war with the elves; either Asta, a devil user be blamed for the events, or the Magic Knights would have to be investigated. As the Magic Knights (the overwhelmingly vast majority are nobility) are the core of the Clover Kingdom's defenses, he called the choice obvious. Corrupt Politician: As the chairman of the Magic Parliament, he essentially is the legal authority of the kingdom. He also tries Asta and Nero in a sham trial to find someone to blame, even attempting to kill Marie to do so, as the alternative would mean blaming the Magic Knights (who it should be noted had no control over their possession) and getting into the legal scandal of so many nobles being tried as criminals. Everyone Has Standards:Theanime-exclusive arcof the Devil Banishers shows that, in spite of being willing to frame innocents in order to save the kingdom, he's more concerned about the imminent threat of the Spade Kingdom than condemning Asta and Nero, coming across as more professional compared to his more radical subordinates.When a Devil from the Spade Kingdom invades the Clover Kingdom, he still cooperates with Julius in an attempt to stop it, and doesn't interfere with Asta when he arrives to kill it. It shows that just like in the anime filler arc, he's still more concerned about the safety of the Clover Kingdom than tryin

characters.name: Dazu Tayak
characters.description: Ambiguously Bi: Dazu was married to her husband Vide before he died from the elves' attack. Sometime before the Elf Reincarnation arc, Dazu encountered a female apothecary named Bow Nocde, and it is heavily implied that the former has romantic feelings for her based on their intimacy with each other more than with her husband. Berserk Button: From her flashback during the Elf Reincarnation incident, Vide pushed Dazu's button one last time before his death by calling her "a good-for-nothing wench" under his dying breath, causing her to turn back on him out of pure revenge. Energy Absorption: Despite that she has a minimal amount of magic power, Dazu's Catalyst Magic allows her to borrow someone's magic to use it as her own within her proximity. I Let Gwen Stacy Die: A revenge example. Dazu let her husband die in a rubble during the elves' attack because he and his mother exploited her to gain superiority. Dazu herself thought that they truly deserved to die because of it. Jerk with a Heart of Gold: With everything that she had been through, Dazu became vengeful towards people in the Clover Kingdom, going as far as letting Vide and her mother to die during the elves' attack (although justified due to their terrible treatment towards her), and killing three of her members upon revealing her intentions as a Devil Believer. Nonetheless, she truly cares for her fellow believers, especially towards Bow.

characters.name: Bow Nocde
characters.description: Ambiguously Gay: Sometime after meeting Dazu, it is heavily implied that Bow had developed romantic feelings for her, in stark contrast to how the latter's husband treated her. Green Thumb: Like Mimosa, Bow possesses Plant Magic, but as an apothecary with no experienced fighting skills, she only specializes in producing medicinal herbs. Hair of Gold, Heart of Gold: Downplayed after the elves attack her hometown, and out of revenge, Bow kidnapped Secre, Marie, and later Asta, killed three of her members for going against her real objectives as a Devil Believer, and believed that the Magic Knights failed to protect her hometown during the elves' attack. Regardless, she cares for her fellow people who sought power from the devils, especially towards Dazu. Labcoat of Science and Medicine: She wears a labcoat as part of her normal outfit. Poison Is Evil: Shortly after the Devil Banishers' failed attempt to execute Secre and Marie, Bow created poison water for Siona and Onoby upon revealing the true intentions as Devil Believers.

characters.name: Revchi Salik
characters.description: A thief who is a former member of the Purple Orcas.Wields Chain Magic, summoning chains tipped withsnake heads. Animal Motifs:Snakes, specifically vipers. Their heads adorn his chains, he strikes swiftly, has a spell named after them, and like popular visions of the animal he's sharp-tongued, condescending, sly and sneaky. Asshole Victim: Was apparently so unpopular within his squad that no one felt sorry for him when he got set up and kicked out, with Gueldre even telling him that he brought it all upon himself. Back for the Dead:He and Gueldre show up for the first time since the Elf Invasion arc during the battle against Lucius... only for the latter to promptly kill them off and steal their magics. Eventually subverted when Julius rewinds the kingdom back to its original state, bringing all the dead back to life. Blade on a Rope: His "Binding Iron Chain Formation" summons chains with tipped ends to embed themselves into the ground and immobilize anyone trapped within them. His "Dance of the Pitless Viper" summons chains with snake heads attached to them that inflict extra damage to his opponents.

characters.name: Neige
characters.description: A mage who works with his brother, Baro, to abduct children.Possesses Snow Magic, allowing him to create and manipulate snow. Anti-Villain: While he did use his magic to hypnotize and kidnap several children, fully knowing that Baro was planning on draining them of their magic, he's also shown to beAffably Evil, deeply lonely, emotionally stunted, and clearly influenced by his violent brother. He quickly comes to regret his actions after Sally turns Baro into a monster, putting an end to his brother's rampage himself and accepting to face justice. The Atoner: Willingly turns himself to go to prison at Asta's urging. He's later seen assisting Theresa with the church children. Berserk Button: Marie calling him out on his use of magic to manipulate the children, saying that no friend would act like this, sends him into a brief rage that causes him to strike her. Though given what we see of his relationship withBaro,it's not a mystery where he gets that from. Elemental Hair Colors: He has white hair with a blue tint, and uses Snow Magic.

characters.name: Baro
characters.description: A brutish thug coercing his brother Neige into abducting children, in order to extract their mana as a lucrative activity.Can manipulate Mud Magic to create mud golems. Big Brother Bully: He frequently insults and puts down Neige, orders him around, doesn't hesitate to hurt him when he's displeased with his behavior, and even plans on leaving him behind after Sally heals him. Carpet of Virility: His open shirt shows his hairy chest, giving him a boorish appearance. Dishing Out Dirt: Uses mud magic. Elemental Motifs: Mud, matchinghis magicand befitting aFat Bastardwilling to subject children to a horrible fate for a quick buckand is outright abusive to his own brother.

characters.name: Paplo Espuma
characters.description: A servant for House Silva. He uses Bubble Magic to heal others. Healing Hands: He uses his magic to heal the injured Nebra and Nozel. Heal It with Water: His Bubble Magic forms healing bubbles. Making a Splash: He uses Bubble Magic to form healing bubbles in a seashell. Meaningful Name: His surname Espuma is Spanish for foam, which fits with his Bubble Magic.

characters.name: Licita
characters.description: A woman whose body absorbed magic and life from those near her. She adopted the devil in Asta's grimoire, Liebe, as her son.Her magic let her store mana-less things inside other objects. All of the Other Reindeer: She told Liebe that she would give him, a devil, a run for his money in being loathed, since her body's special condition drains magic and life force from the people around her. Bag of Holding: Her magic acted as this, letting her store large amounts of mana-less things inside tiny bottles that she carried around. Daddy Had a Good Reason for Abandoning You: She left Asta at the church because her body steals magic and life from things near her and keeping her son could very well have killed him. Death by Origin Story: She dies in her efforts to stop Lucifero from taking over Liebe's body.

characters.name: Makusa North
characters.description: A researcher in the Clover Kingdom's Magic Tool Research Lab.He uses Snow Magic to create snowmen. Canon Immigrant: He first appeared in Episode 140, working with Sally and bringing her to the Black Bulls so that she can experiment on them to create a mana-increasing magic tool for fighting the Spade Kingdom. He makes his manga appearance in Chapter 274, as part of the special assault force against the Spade Kingdom. An Ice Person: Makusa uses Snow Magic to form snowmen that help the Spade Kingdom civilians hide from the devils. Ink-Suit Actor: He is a character based on Daisuke Sakuma, a singer in the band Snow Man who sang the anime's eleventh opening. Meaningful Name: His name "Makusa" is an anagram of Sakuma, the surname of his voice actor who he was based off of, and surname "North" is an anagram of "snow" in Japanese, with Daisuke Sakuma being from the band Snow Man.

characters.name: # — C
characters.description: Accidental Pervert: He gets black out drunk in his first experience with alcohol and jumps into the public bath when it was reserved for women. He ends up getting an eyeful from Ichika, which immediately sobered him up out of fear for his life. Action Hero: A sword-wielding Magic Knight who aspires to become the Wizard King and fights against enemies of the kingdom. Adaptational Muscles: Inverted. While the rest of the Black Bulls are portrayed as toned and muscular in the anime, Asta's own muscles, which were a major reveal in the early chapters of the story, are far less detailed and prominent by comparison — until we get past theTime Skip, where he'sallmuscle. All-Loving Hero:He shows this trait whenever someone picks on the weak, elderly, and otherwise powerless:Heath:[to Asta]But, surely you can see what insignificant creatures they truly are.Asta:[angrily]You may think they're nothing but useless beasts, but I'll do whatever I have to to protect them!He refuses to let anyone die if he can help it. Even his enemies aren't exempt from this, hence why he asks his teammates to save Mars during the Dungeon Exploration Arc.He also refuses tosee the Devil in his grimoire as evil, despitethe Devil itselfand Nacht advising him not to, leading Asta befriending said Devil. Helped by how that's actually his mother's adopted son. He shows this trait whenever someone picks on the weak, elderly, and otherwise powerless:

characters.name: Yami Sukehiro
characters.description: The Captain of the Black Bulls. A foreigner from an eastern country, he was welcomed into the Magic Knights by the current Wizard King, Julius. Trusted by his squad, Yami is a rough man with strange ways of leadership who's reliable in an emergency. Yami uses Dark Magic, which can cover his blade in darkness to launch black crescent-shaped blasts or suck magical attacks into a black hole. He uses it in combination with his ki sensing to fight. Ability Mixing: After the six month time skip, Yami can combine reading ki withMana Zone, letting him react to moves before they're made. Absurd Phobia: AfterAsta's blasted to the Land of the Sun by a Lucius-controlled Sister Lily, Ryuya tells Asta thatYami's scared of moths. Accidental Hero: Yami outright stated that he didn't care if Vanessa came with him or not after he accidentally broke through her life-long birdcage when he was being chased in the Forest of Witches. However, his statement that hedoesn't care about fate and Vanessa should control her own destinygave her the courage to leave with him, escaping from her mother and joining the Black Bulls, her true family. And it's later revealed that he broke Charlotte's childhood curse when he got annoyed after her out-of-control vines spilled his pasta soup, and he went to see what the ruckus was about. His recognition of her strength and offer to help her so that she doesn't have to shoulder all her burdens herself led Charlotte to fall in love with him, breaking her curse.

characters.name: Nacht Faust
characters.description: The mysterious Vice Captain of the Black Bulls who has been serving as a spy in the Spade Kingdom. Nacht is a blunt man who hates the Black Bulls, but works with them and the other Magic Knights to stop the Dark Triad. Like Asta, he's devil-possessed and teaches him how to use his devil's power. Nacht is the host of four different devils: Gimodelo, Slotos, Plumede, and Walgner. Nacht uses Shadow Magic, able to move himself and whatever he touches from one shadow to another. All-Encompassing Mantle: He wears a long cloak, and is the Black Bulls' Vice Captain introduced well into the story who has been serving as a spy within the Spade Kingdom. All Your Powers Combined: He's the host offourdifferent devils, and can undergoDevil Unionwith each of them, conferring onto him one of their attributes: summoning a pack of wolf humanoids, covering him in a tough, heavy armor, increasing his agility, or unleashing paralyzing sound waves. He can even use Devil Unions with the powers of two devils, like with Gallus x Felis and Canis x Equus. Aloof Ally: The Vice Captain of the Black Bulls who's been a spy in the Spade Kingdom, buthatesthe squad for their character flaws and doesn't even like the other Magic Knights captains. His constant smiling and closed eyes yet perpetual emotionlessness, pragmatism, black-and-white morality, and being the host offourdifferent devils make him an enigmatic ally to Asta and the rest of the Magic Knights.

characters.name: Liebe
characters.description: The devil inside Asta's grimoire and the source of his Anti-Magic. He rarely appears for most of the manga, only speaking occasionally to Asta, before we finally get his character and backstory in the Spade Kingdom Raid arc. All of the Other Reindeer: As a devil born without any magic, and devils liking to terrorize those beneath them due to the boredom of the underworld, he was abused every day until a high-ranking devil threw him at the gate of the underworld, which he could pass through thanks to having no magic. Anti-Hero: He's a terrifying, rude, and occasionally cruel devil who wants to take over Asta's body, but as revealed he wants to use said body to kill all other devils and free the world of their cruel manipulations, and beyond that he turns out to be honorable and true to his word. Anti-Magic: He has no magic at all, and is the source of Asta's anti-magic. Bash Brothers: He becomes this with Asta, his actual adoptive brother at that. They defeat Lilith and Naamah together, with Liebe grateful for Asta for letting him do so, complete with a wrist bump after their time in Devil Union runs out.

characters.name: Gimodelo, Slotos, Plumede, & Walgner
characters.description: Animal Motifs: Each of them:Gimodelo's is a dog. In its normal form Gimodelo has a canine form with a dog mask, its Devil Union Mode with Nacht is called Canis, and its characteristic is"pack".Slotos' is a donkey. In its normal form Slotos has an equine form with a donkey mask, its Devil Union Mode with Nacht is called Equus, and its characteristic is"toughness".Plumede's is a cat. In its normal form Plumede has a feline form with a cat mask, its Devil Union Mode with Nacht is called Felis, and its characteristic is"agility".Walgner's is a rooster. In its normal form Walgner has an avian form with a rooster mask, its Devil Union Mode with Nacht is called Gallus, and its characteristic is"call". Gimodelo's is a dog. In its normal form Gimodelo has a canine form with a dog mask, its Devil Union Mode with Nacht is called Canis, and its characteristic is"pack". Slotos' is a donkey. In its normal form Slotos has an equine form with a donkey mask, its Devil Union Mode with Nacht is called Equus, and its characteristic is"toughness". Plumede's is a cat. In its normal form Plumede has a feline form with a cat mask, its Devil Union Mode with Nacht is called Felis, and its characteristic is"agility". Walgner's is a rooster. In its normal form Walgner has an avian form with a rooster mask, its Devil Union Mode with Nacht is called Gallus, and its characteristic is"call".

characters.name: Finral Roulacase
characters.description: A casanova who was disowned from the high-ranking noble Vaude family that likes to hit on women whenever he has the chance to. Despite that, he is still one of the most level-headed and less explosive members of the Black Bulls, resulting in him having quite a bit of responsibility.Uses Spatial Magic to create portals for transportation. However, he is inept at using it offensively and dislikes fighting. Abusive Parents: He was verbally abused and disowned by his father andWicked Stepmother. Amazon Chaser: After he sees Mimosa fight in the Royal Knights Exam, he calls her "the complete package" of beauty, grace and magical power. Big Brother Instinct: Despite his younger half-brother Langris' abuse of him, Finral still greatly cares for him and regrets not bonding with him during their childhood. It shows when he tries to save him when he's possessed by an elf. Big Damn Heroes:He comes just in time to save Finnes from being killed by Latry's Spatial Magic.Arrives at the scene after Zenon becomes a devil and overwhelms Yuno to save Langris and team up with him against the Triad member.

characters.name: Magna Swing
characters.description: A loud mouthed Magic Knight with the looks of a delinquent. He was indeed a former delinquent that joined the Magic Knights once he was inspired by the mayor of his village and is a much nicer guy once one proves their worth.Uses Flame Magic, primarily to throw several types of fireball with different effects. Tying in to his baseball theme, Magna can also conjure up flaming sport shoes or fiery baseball bats. Adaptation Expansion: In the anime, his backstory involves the mayor of Saussy, which is why Magna gets angrier with Heath than he does in the manga. Ain't Too Proud to Beg: Despite his rough attitude, Magna gets on his knees andbegsZora to teach him how to fight like him, frustrated that he can't learn the Heart Kingdom's Mana Method and not wanting to let Luck pull ahead of him and drag the Black Bulls down. Always Second Best: He started as this with Luck. No matter how hard Magna trains, Luck is simply more talented with unmatchable battle instincts. This became painfully clear after the latter's power boost following his elf reincarnation, and the gap between them only increased afterMagna failed to learn Mana Method because of his low mana when they went to Heart Kingdom together. The fear of being left behind,amongst other reasons, fuelsMagna's determinationto become stronger in his own way, leading him to beg Zora to train him. Arrogant Kung-Fu Guy: Comes across as this at first. However, after Asta beats him, he sheds the arrogant facade and reveals himself to be a pretty amiable fellow from the sticks.It's later revealed that, underneath the cocky fiery attitude Magna is deeply insecure that he's weak and unable to face the other Black Bulls after learning that he's unable to learn Mana Method until he's become stronger in his own way.

characters.name: Luck Voltia
characters.description: An upbeat and friendly boy eager for strong opponents to fight with, and capable of great magical feats and magic sensing. He was brought up by his mother to always win and become strong.Uses Lightning Magic, manipulating lightning most often by conjuring magical greaves and gauntlets. Abusive Mom: Luck's mother mistreated him for his inability to stop smiling, with a flashback showing her slapping him at one point while bitterly wondering why he was born like that. She only began to show him affection when he beat a noble with magic, which began his pathological desire to win fights. All Girls Want Bad Boys: Subverted. A girl at a mixer starts falling for the gap between his cute looks anddangerouspersonality but she's soon put off. Always Someone Better: Represents this for Magna. No matter how hard Magna trains,Luck is simply more talented with unmatchable battle instincts. This became painfully clear after Luck's power boost following his elf reincarnation, and the gap between them only increased after Magna failed to learn Mana Method because of his low mana when they went to Heart Kingdom together. It's a bit different from Luck's angle, however, ashe always had a feeling that Magna would become someone interestingandkept messing with him to push him forward. Anti-Hero: The best way to describe Luck's personality would be "What if we tookSon Goku, amped up hisBlood Knighttraits to morally grey levels, and toned down most of hisAll-Loving Herotendencies?". While cheerful on the surface, Luck has a near sociopathic personality where he does not seem to be able to show any expressions but joy, a trait that always confused his mother. He also has a deep fondness of fighting and defeating his opponents. He can even suggest on putting his opponent into a near death condition without losing his smiles, which earned him the nickname Smiling Battle Maniac. Luck also has an obsession over victory against his opponent without any outside assistance, which stems from his

characters.name: Gauche Adlai
characters.description: A man obsessed with his little sister and whose primary objective is to dedicate himself to her. He was born to the noble Adlai family but was cast out after his parents' deaths. Thus, he became a violent, vulgar ex-criminal who has a very hard time working with his fellow knights.Uses Mirror Magic, being capable of firing lasers by reflecting light, and duplicating someone, most often himself. Adaptation Dye-Job: The anime makes his light brown hair a darker purple shade. Additionally, he is shown to have pale blue eyes in the manga, while the anime follows his original eye color and goes with brown. Ain't Too Proud to Beg: Despite his rudeness, Gauche gets on his knees and begs Finralof all peopleto take him back to Yami and Asta so that he can save them, giving Finralno choice but to accept his request. Alternate Universe: One of the aspects of his Mirror Magic is that he's able to bring an alternate version of himself from the mirror world to assist him in combat, effectively doubling his combat power. Anger Born of Worry: After the elven spirits are exorcised from his and Marie's bodies, Gauche snaps at Asta and the other Black Bulls for risking their lives and getting their hideout destroyed for his sake,pointing out every reason why they should've left a scumbag like him alone. This moment is soon followed by aGrudging "Thank You", as the Black Bulls see right through his act and ask him to look at them.

characters.name: Vanessa Enoteca
characters.description: Vanessa is a Magic Knight that loves drinking and has a penchant for hitting on and seducing men she finds attractive. Aside from that, she is a skilled mage and a cool and friendly woman who likes to help newcomers. She is originally from the Forest of Witches, but after meeting Yami she left against the wishes of the Witch Queen.She uses Thread Magic, a magic able to manipulate threads to make clothes or objects, and change the thread of fate itself. Action Girl: She's a capable fighter, using magical threads to trap enemies and turn them into her puppets. The Alcoholic: She loves her alcoholic drinks and is often drunk at the Black Bulls' base. She's known as a "Booze-Loving Witch" for a reason. Not to mention that she also provides the page image for the Manga's "Drinking Game" page. All Witches Have Cats: After her "red thread of fate" power manifests itself, she's often accompanied by her cat familiar, Rouge. Animal Motifs: Cats. She's a beautiful, sultry woman who spends a lot of her time lounging around and sleeping, and is a witch whose magic over fate takes the form of a red cat.

characters.name: Charmy Pappitson
characters.description: A quirky and friendly girl with a love for eating nearly obscene amounts of food like it's nothing. Usually harmless, keeping her from eating or stealing/destroying her food causes her to go absolutely ballistic.Uses Cotton Magic, a type of magic that allows her to create cotton which can form fluffy sheep. She later manifests Food Magic, forming a giant wolf for her to eat other magic and use the eaten magic power with hers to unleash enhanced punches. Action Girl: She has her moments when she's serious, creating a giant sheep to pummel enemies. After expressing her dwarf heritage, she can eat enemies' magic and punch them with magically reinforced punches. And This Is for...: Parodied when she fights Lira with reinforced punches for rejecting her food."This is for the protein!!! This one's for the fat!!! And this one is for the caaaaaarbs!!!!" Animal Motifs:Her magic lets her create sheeps from cotton, and she's usually peaceful and soft-mannered. However, like a ram, she has an aggressive side. When she awakens her Dwarven heritage, she switches to wolves, which represent her dangerousness and large appetite.Sylph also disparagingly calls her a "raccoon" because she's small, is a pest to her for Yuno's affection, and can eat anything in large amounts. Her magic lets her create sheeps from cotton, and she's usually peaceful and soft-mannered. However, like a ram, she has an aggressive side. When she awakens her Dwarven heritage, she switches to wolves, which represent her dangerousness and large appetite.

characters.name: Gordon Agrippa
characters.description: An odd man who wears all black and constantly mumbles to himself. Despite his creepy appearance and mannerisms, he's actually a very friendly person.He uses Poison Magic to form poisonous masses which have the additional effects of hexes. Adaptation Expansion: The anime shows his personality off a lot more, and shows what happens to him while the rest of the Black Bulls go off to the Underwater Temple. Animal Motifs: Gordon can form badgers out of his magic. Although said badgers are made of poison and chew through limbs, he's actually very friendly and down to earth, fitting with the more positive associations of the animal. Bad Powers, Good People:Uses cursed poison that can melt the flesh off an enemy's bones, but is a genuinely nice person who doesn't like to hurt anyone.He studies under his father, who has been using the family's knowledge on curses and poisons to create medical treatments, during the six month time skip. Uses cursed poison that can melt the flesh off an enemy's bones, but is a genuinely nice person who doesn't like to hurt anyone.

characters.name: Grey
characters.description: A seemingly huge man whose true appearance is concealed. In truth, she's an extremely shy woman who is constantly embarrassed in her true appearance.Seemingly a master of Transformation Magic, able to shapeshift into anyone and transform other objects as well, including the magic of others. Her true magic is later revealed to be Transmutation Magic, letting her change the structure of a substance. Abusive Parents: Grey's stepmother greatly mistreated her, calling her ugly and forcing her to do all the house's chores while pampering her own daughters. All Girls Want Bad Boys:Subverted; Grey develops emotional affection towards Gauche becausehe showed sincere interest in her abilities and motivated her to stay in her true form. Furthermore, her life wassaved by himin the past, and it's thanks to him that Grey gained the courage to thrive and survive when no one else cared about her. Gauche himself, while rude and rough around the edges, is noted to be close friends with her and Gordon. Apologises a Lot: Tends to say sorry often regarding her constant extreme shyness. It's revealed that she's had this trait since living with her cruel stepfamily, who forced her to do all the house chores. Bedsheet Ghost: In the color pages of Chapter 84, her costume is a bedsheet ghost, which is taken off by Vanessa.

characters.name: Noelle Silva
characters.description: Noelle is a silver-haired royal from the prestigious House of Silva, as well as a member of the Black Bulls. Befitting her upbringing, she can come off as arrogant and cold at times as a defense mechanism due to her insecurities. However she grows to treat people equally and overcome her trauma to become a powerful Magic Knight. She eventually develops romantic feelings for Asta but is in denial about them. As the youngest daughter of the late Acier Silva — and sister to Nozel, Nebra, and Solid Silva — Noelle has incredible magical potential, with Noelle using Water Magic. Unfortunately for her, she lacks fine control, resulting in collateral damage and being mocked by her own family. As a result, Noelle has veered towards defensive magic, mostly protective bubbles. Eventually she gains enough confidence to develop offensive magic and veer towards being a strong attack mage, thanks to her squad offering support and care. Action Girl: Starts off as anAction Survivorbut develops into this over time as she improves hermagic control, becoming an integral member of the main team with the offensive and defensive properties of herwater magic. She fully evolves into one when she obtains her Valkyrie Armor, manifesting an armor to fight in close combat with a lance and spells. Action Survivor: As a result of being unable to properly control her magic, she can't do anything to help Asta and Magna on their first mission until the motivation to save a little girl allows Noelle to manifest a defensive spell. From then on she acts as a defense mage until the "Underwater Temple Arc", during which she manages to harness her magic offensively during the fight against Vetto. Adaptational Early Appearance: She appears in the anime earlier than in her manga debut (where she's already in the Black Bulls base observing how Asta gets his Magic Knight robe), preparing to take the exam to become a Magic Knight before Nozel stops her, claiming that since her squad has already been decided an

characters.name: Zora Ideale
characters.description: A mysterious and eccentric man who comes into the Royal Knight Tournament unannounced. Zora has dedicated himself to punishing corrupt Magic Knights due to his father's death. He enjoys playing pranks on others and getting under people's skin, but actually has great observation and analytical skill.Uses Ash Magic in conjunction with Trap Magic, being capable of drawing magic symbols that unleash a variety of traps when triggered. Never confronts his enemies directly, preferring to befuddle them and trick them into defeating themselves. Aloof Ally: Zora's this after officially joining the Black Bulls, leaving the hideout without telling the others and refusing to go with Magna and Luck to train in the Heart Kingdom. That said, he does bond with Magna over their shared peasant background and they travel together a lot over the six month time skip. Anime Hair: Zora has crimson red hair that flares up like flames. Anti-Hero: Easily the most morally grey member of the Black Bulls. He dedicates himself to brutally taking down corrupt Magic Knights and is quite rude to his fellow squadmates. Arc Hero: For the Royal Knights Arc, with Zora becoming part of Asta's team in the Royal Knights Exam, the reveal of his backstory which ties into the story's themes of discrimination, him playing a part in Langris' defeat, and the ending of the arc implying, and later it being confirmed, that he's a Black Bull.

characters.name: Henry Legolant
characters.description: The true owner of the Black Bulls' hideout who is confined to the squad's headquarters because his illness requires him to siphon magic from living beings. Henry is laidback and speaks slowly. He has secretly been watching over the Black Bulls and been mistaken as a ghost living in the hideout.His Recombination Magic can restructure the Black Bulls' hideout to his liking. Abusive Parents: Henry's father who not only wanted to disown him from the moment of his birth to keep him from disgracing the family's name with his illness, but also referred to him as "that".Downplayed with his mother who didn't accept him but still regarded him as their child and was initially terrified by her husband's claims. Downplayed with his mother who didn't accept him but still regarded him as their child and was initially terrified by her husband's claims. Barefoot Loon: Henry does not wear any shoes, but while heisn'ta loon, he is a quirky shut-in who cannot leave the hideout because of his illness. Beneficial Disease: To some extent. All the magic he's accumulated from the Black Bulls is used to make the base an upright bull, and this helps them fight off the Eye of the Midnight Sun members, thoughthey still get what they want in the end. And Gordon using his Curse-Worker's Neighbor spell on him lets himtarget whose magic his curse illness drains.

characters.name: Secre Swallowtail/Nero
characters.description: An anti-bird that has taken a liking to Asta. In truth, she's the bird form of Secre Swallowtail. A servant of the first Wizard King, Lumiere Silvamillion Clover, she helped develop the magic tools he worked on to achieve his dream of equality within the kingdom. On the day of the elf massacre, Secre saved Lumiere using Forbidden Magic, at the cost of spending centuries as a bird. She later joins the Black Bulls. She uses Sealing Magic, an ancient magic that has been affected by her use of Forbidden Magic, allowing her to seal and unseal objects, individuals, and even damage. Adaptation Dye-Job: The anime turns her black hair in her human form dark blue. Alliterative Name: Her true name,SecreSwallowtail. Funnily enough, Noelle's suggestion for her name was also alliterative and began with an S,SilvantusSchnauzer. Aloof Dark-Haired Girl: Black hair in her human form that's given a bluer shade in the anime, described as a cool beauty by Finral, and generally very calm and apathetic.

characters.name: Golden Dawn in General
characters.description: The Ace: They are the strongest Magic Knight squad in the Clover Kingdom, consistently earning the most stars. Aristocrat Team: Save for Yuno, the squad is comprised of only nobility and royalty, which causes most of its members to shun Yuno when he first joins. And as it turns out later,Yuno was actually born a former Spade royal, meaning that thewholesquad is literally made out of aristocrats. Color Motif: Gold. The squad is the highest-ranked and made up entirely of nobility and royalty. (Yes, this includesYuno in a sense.) Cosmic Motifs: The sun, being their symbol and reflecting their status as ashining example of what Magic Knights should be. Vangeance chose the name tobring warmth and light to the world. Dramatic Irony: They deride Yuno for his peasant origins before eventually warming up to him as one of them.Little did they know that Yuno was from the House of Grinberryall who was sent away from Spade Kingdom and lived in Hage for his safety.

characters.name: William Vangeance
characters.description: The captain of the Golden Dawn, a mysterious man who hides his face behind a mask. Little is known about him.Uses World Tree Magic, capable of creating huge trees that absorb mana from within the earth. Once harvested, this natural mana can be converted and re-used by Vangeance for various purposes. The Ace: He's the Captain of the strongest Magic Knight squad and said to be the mage closest to becoming the Wizard King. All of the Other Reindeer: He grew up shunned by others because of the curse on his face. This is why he's so loyal to Patry, who befriended and came to understand him. Apocalypse Maiden: With Vangeance's World Tree Magic combined with Yami's Dark Magic, they can form the Tree of Qliphoth, which would bring demons to the living world and kill over 90% of the continent's population. The Atoner: He becomes this after the events of the elf reincarnation incident in the Clover Kingdom for not doing enough to stop Patry.

characters.name: Langris Vaude
characters.description: The younger Vaude brother. A direct underling of Vangeance as the Vice-Captain of Golden Dawn, and somewhat of a sadist.Like his brother, Langris has an affinity for Spatial Magic. Unlike his brother, Langris's spells erase whole chunks of space, tearing holes through magic, immobile objects and living persons alike. The Ace: The second most powerful member of Golden Dawn and the heir to his family due to his powerful Spatial Magic. Always Someone Better: Growing up, he was superior to Finral in magic, academics, and athletics, with his Spatial Magic much more powerful than him and causing their father to favor Langris. Arc Villain: He's the closest thing the Royal Knights Arc has to one, with his near-murder of Finral putting him into conflict with the Black Bulls and raising the question of whether an elf is possessing his body. Arranged Marriage: Betrothed to a royal named Finnes, whom he finds to be plain. It doesn't help that she and Finral have a thing for each other, just one more thing about his brother that annoys him.

characters.name: Mimosa Vermillion
characters.description: A shy and sweet young royal and a newcomer to the Golden Dawn, like Yuno. Her unassuming demeanor hides a small mean streak, which melts away once she completes a mission alongside her cousin Noelle.Mimosa specializes in Plant Magic, with most of her spells revolving around healing her teammates or scouting the area. Adaptation Dye-Job: In the manga Mimosa’s eyes are yellow but in other adaptations such as the anime or video games Mimosa’s eyes are instead changed to being green. Action Girl: She is training to become this after being inspired by her love for Asta, learning attack spells. She fully evolves into one after the six month timeskip, using her magic to fight Vanica's Dark Disciple herself. Alien Kudzu: Weaponized. After the time skip, she can use magic-controlling weed seeds that rapidly grow all over the Dark Disciple she fights. All-Loving Heroine: Mimosa is very kind and caring, having compassion for peasants since a young age despite her royal upbringing. So much so that she'll heal anyone to save them from dying regardless of their race, even if they're an enemy.

characters.name: Klaus Lunettes
characters.description: An arrogant and serious member of a noble family that dislikes the new peasant recruit Yuno. After completing a dungeon alongside Asta and Yuno, he significantly mellows out and strives to improve both his behavior and his magic. He becomes friends with Asta and Yuno from that point forward.Uses Steel Magic, manipulating metal to forge a variety of finely-crafted items, such as barricades, spears, drills, or chariots. Adaptation Expansion: He appears much earlier in the anime, introducing himself to Yuno. Arrogant Kung-Fu Guy: He never stops flaunting the superior magical reserves of nobility and believes that commoners such as the Black Bulls are nothing more than trash. He isn't actually as powerful as he thinks he is as he is quickly trashed by Mars, and Yuno is forced to stay with him rather than going to the Treasure Room. However, his defeat against Mars and the latter being then beaten by Asta and Yuno forces him to reconsider his opinions and he is quick to admit he was wrong. The Beautiful Elite: Klaus is a noble of the Clover Kingdom and in Assorted Question Brigade No.2 it’s stated that he’s the fifth most beautiful man when he doesn’t have his glasses on. Blue Blood: He's constantly talking about how he's a member of the nobility.

characters.name: Sylph
characters.description: The spirit of wind, whom Yuno gives the nickname Bell. Blow You Away: She is the elemental spirit of Wind. Can't Hold Her Liquor: She takes one sip of alcohol before passing out in the hot spring. Clingy Jealous Girl: Has a comedic rivalry with Charmy due to their feelings for Yuno. Death Glare: She tells Jack to be quiet when he mocks Yuno forhaving lost to Zenon with an angry look on her face, storing mana to take down the Bone Mage.

characters.name: Alecdora Sandler
characters.description: A haughty and not-so-mighty Golden Dawn knight, Alecdora has sworn eternal allegiance to William Vangeance. Secretly harbors a murderous grudge against Yuno because of his magical prowess and quick rise through the ranks.Alecdora wields Sand Magic, summoning golems of sand to battle in his stead, or conjuring clumps of sand to crush and let suffocate his targets. Arrogant Kung-Fu Guy: Worse than Klaus. To make this point clear, he throws insults ateveryonein the room. Break the Haughty: At the Royal Knights Selection Exam, Yuno casually destroys his strongest spell without even using Spirit Magic, leaving him in disbelief:Yuno:Once you stumble, you elites sure are fragile. Curb-Stomp Battle:He gets curb-stomped by Yuno during their match at the Royal Knights Exam.Zenon quickly defeats him when him and his Dark Disciples attack Golden Dawn.
