He gets curb-stomped by Yuno during their match at the Royal Knights Exam.

characters.name: Shiren Tium
characters.description: A nobleman and a 1st Class Intermediate Magic Knight. He is never fazed and always calm and collected.Shiren is a practitioner of Stone Magic. He can create a real-time detailed model of his surroundings, which includes the positions of his allies and enemies. Often brought into various military operations as a result. The Big Guy: Subverted. Despite being a tall and muscular individual, who wields stone as an element, he actually functions as aSupport Party Member. Dishing Out Dirt: Uses Stone Magic to form a location model. Early-Bird Cameo: He appears unnamed in Chapter 2, demonstrating how to fly on a broom. Elemental Weapon: When Zenon and his Dark Disciples attack Golden Dawn, he forms an axe out of his Stone Magic.

characters.name: Hamon Caseus
characters.description: A nobleman and a 2nd Class Intermediate Magic Knight who is always jolly and enthusiastic.His Glass Magic conjures up shards of glass to cut through his targets. Adaptational Jerkass: A minor case. In the manga, Asta's criticized for eating in a way that the nobles find disgusting, but it isn't shown who says it. In the anime, Hamon's depicted as saying it, which kind of fits with how much he loves food. Big Eater: Likes to eat food, and even shares his food with his teammates and Charmy, a fellow food lover. Big Fun: He's a chubby man who's cheerful and jolly, sharing his food with others. Elemental Motifs: Glass, matching his magic.

characters.name: David Swallow
characters.description: A nobleman who is a member of the Golden Dawn. He uses Dice Magic, with his spells' power dependent on his dice roll. The Gambler: He uses Dice Magic, with its power dependent on the number of pips rolled. Inconsistent Spelling: His last name is spelled as "Slower" in Episode 141. Nice Guy: He's an easygoing, friendly guy. Randomized Damage Attack: His spell Gambler's Fallacy unleashes a magic blast with its power dependent on his rolled dice pips.

characters.name: Letoile Becquerel
characters.description: A member of the Golden Dawn. She uses Compass Magic to manifest compasses that can change spells' trajectories and make her attacks lock on a target. Attack Reflector: Her magic creates compasses that change the trajectory of incoming attacks. Barrier Warrior: She can manifest compasses in front of herself or others to redirect attacks. Bespectacled Cutie: She wears a pair of glasses and is referred to as a cutie by Finral and promptly asked out by him. Enclosed Space: Another Atlas creates one under a compass that disrupts enemies' mana. Unlike Kivn, she can't make one as giant when they fight against Zenon's Dark Disciples.

characters.name: Silver Eagles in General
characters.description: Animal Motifs: Eagles. They are a proud group who take pride in their status as nobility and royalty. Nozel, the captain, forms an eagle out of his Mercury Magic. Their outfits also have extensions resembling feathers. Anime Hair: Unlike Noelle and Acier, Nozel, Nebra, and Solid each haveweird and unusual hairstyles. Aristocrat Team: The Silver Eagles are an elite group of Magic Knights. Founded and run by the highborn Silva family, the Silver Eagles have high standards and only allow nobles into their ranks, seeing anyone of lower class to not being worth the effort. Arrogant Kung-Fu Guy: A trait they share with most nobles. They are very prideful of their magic and can't handle the idea that commoners or peasants can be good with magic. The Atoner:The Final Arc has all of the Silva children fight against their mother Acier, which allowed Nozel to reforge his bonds with his younger siblings. Meanwhile, Solid and Nebra's witness of seeing Noelle becoming stronger made them help her defeat their mother and realize how awful they've been to her since childhood.

characters.name: Nozel Silva
characters.description: The oldest of the Silva siblings and the captain of the Silver Eagles. He is a rude but competent man. He has a rivalry with Fuegoleon, the captain of the Crimson Lion Kings.Uses Mercury Magic, which manipulates mercury in its liquid state. Ability Mixing: Noticeably, his magic has traits of the magical attributes of both of his parents. He inherited the steel attribute of his mother in the shape of mercury manipulation, and the water attribute of his father as the mercury he uses is liquid rather than solid like the steel of Acier. Adults Are Useless: Played with. To start off, Nozel showed nothing but disdain for Noelle since their mother's death, seeing her as a living disappointment to the Silva family with a lack of controlling her own magic. In addition, he didn't do anything to reprimandNebraorSolidfor abusing her nonstop because ofthosereasons. However, what Nozel did is a ruse to protect Noelle by making her jointhe Black Bulls, and he even admitted that he was afraid to lose her due toher heavy resemblance of Acier,who died from Megicula's curse that will kill the whole Silva family if anyone finds out, much to his pure guilt. Aloof Big Brother: To Noelle, who he disparaged for being unable to control her magic. However, he did this in order to protect her, not confident that she would become strong enough to become a powerful Magic Knight. Animal Battle Aura: It takes the form of a blue eagle when he confronts Fuegoleon.

characters.name: Nebra Silva
characters.description: A smug and overconfident woman, and is quick to laugh at people. Nebra is the first daughter of the Silva family.Uses Mist Magic, capable of manipulating mist to create clones and contain her enemies. Animal Motifs: Spiders. She forms webs out of mist and is an unpleasant woman who likes toying with her enemies. The Atoner:Like Solid, she puts her own safety on the line for Noelle's sake and specifically states any pain she endures is nothing compared to what she put Noelle through. Beauty Is Bad: Nebra is a beautiful yet unpleasant noblewoman who treated anyone weaker (including her own sister Noelle and the Black Bulls) differently. Beta Bitch: A co-ed variation, as Nebra is usually the one to accompany her oldest brother and squad captain Nozel for public events, and she tends to belittle commoners or weak Magic Knights, including Noelle, in whom the former declared her as "exiled" from the Silva family.

characters.name: Solid Silva
characters.description: A sadistic and arrogant man who took pleasure in making Noelle's life a complete hell when they were kids.Uses Water Magic, manipulating water to form weapons and other things. Adaptational Jerkass: While already a bonafide jerk in the manga, the anime goes a step further by having him pouring water in Noelle's head during the banquet after the Magic Knight promotion ceremony to further humiliate her, while in the manga he only mocks her. Alliterative Name:SolidSilva. Always a Bigger Fish: Finds himself on the receiving end of this to his sister Noelle, much to his shock. Her Sea Dragon's Roareasilyoverpowers his water serpent, even while she was holding back. Animal Motifs:Sea Serpents. He forms them using his water magic and is a sadistic guy who enjoys bullying his younger sister Noelle for years.

characters.name: Acier Silva
characters.description: The former captain of the Silver Eagles, as well as the later mother of Nozel, Nebra, Solid and Noelle. Always Someone Better: Acier was this to Mereoleona as the latter never managed a single win against the former. Years after Acier's death, Mereoleona fondly reminisces on the former's power to Noelle. Back from the Dead: She's one of the Paladins Lucius revived and brought with him in Judgement Day, much to the Silva household's horror. Came Back Wrong: She's revived a second time by Lucius as a horrific monstrosity to the pointMereleona engages her old rival with a promise to lay her to rest and warns Noelle Acier is no longer her mother. Dance Battler: Acier's fighting style resembles "dancing across the battlefield."

characters.name: Rob Vitesse
characters.description: The Silver Eagles' 2nd Class Senior Magic Knight. Blow You Away: He uses Wind Magic, mostly to boost his speed. Elemental Hair Colors: Grey hair to go with Wind Magic. Elemental Speed: Rob uses his Wind Magic to increase his speed, making him considered the fastest mage of the Silver Eagles. Meaningful Name: Vitesse is French for speed. He's considered the fastest member of the Silver Eagles.

characters.name: Curtis Wolne
characters.description: Carry a Big Stick: He can use his Rock Magic to form a giant morning star. Combination Attack: Curtis uses his Strong Bow to fire Forti's Burst Javelins at Team B's crystal, with Rick scoping them with his Crystal Scope. Dishing Out Dirt: Curtis uses Rock Magic to form weapons and a spiked wall. Elemental Weapon:His spell Strong Bow forms a crossbow from rock.He also forms a giant spiked mace. His spell Strong Bow forms a crossbow from rock.

characters.name: Kyle
characters.description: Feather Flechettes: He uses Feather Magic that can do this. Logical Weakness: His Feather Magic is weak against Flame Magic, which burns up feathers quickly.

characters.name: Nils Ragus
characters.description: A 1st Class Intermediate Magic Knight. Elemental Eye Colors: Blue eyes to go with Ice Magic. Elemental Weapon: He can form a sword out of ice to wield. An Ice Person: He uses Ice Magic to form an ice sword and needles. Sharing a Body: With an elf following their reincarnation.

characters.name: Simon
characters.description: Flat Character: Not much is known about him other than he's a member of the Silver Eagles.

characters.name: Mohl
characters.description: Animal Motifs: Moles. His name is a pun on mole and he forms one from his magic. Canon Foreigner: He only appears in the anime. Dishing Out Dirt: He uses Earth Magic to form a giant mole. Elemental Hair Colors: A brunette who uses Earth Magic. Fallen Hero: A former Magic Knight who became a bandit leader.

characters.name: Crimson Lion Kings in General
characters.description: Animal Motifs: Lions. They're a courageous group associated with fire. From Flame Magic, Fuegoleon can form a lion and Mereoleona creates a lion's paw. Arrogant Kung-Fu Guy: Subverted. Unlike most nobles, the Vermillions are friendly and believe that, through training, anyone can become a great Magic Knight. Badass Family: Much like the Silver Eagles, the highest-ranked members are composed by a single family: the Vermillion family. Color Motif: Crimson. The squad is a brave, hot-blooded group who favor usingFlame Magic. Elemental Hair Colors: The Vermillion siblings all have orange-red hair and use flame magic.

characters.name: Fuegoleon Vermillion
characters.description: A strong man with a brotherly and kind personality. He is the widely-respected captain of the Crimson Lion Kings, recognized as a true Magic Knight. He has a rivalry with Nozel, the captain of the Silver Eagles.Uses Flame Magic, manipulating fire to create large forms that can attack the enemy. The Ace: Not only is Fuegoleon immensely powerful even by the standards of theWorld of Badassthe series is set, but the guy's is also deeply respected and incredibly well liked among even the prickliest of his peers:Nozelconsiders him bothThe Rivaland the best example of aWorthy Opponent,Yamioutright scoffs at the notion that Licht could defeat him in a fair fight and guesses the elf only took down Fuegoleon thanks to a sneak attack andMereleonaoutright considers her little brother to beAlways Someone Betterdespite her ridiculously monstrous strength. Not to mention how both Asta and Noelle deeply respect him as a Magic Knight and everyone in the Crimson Lion Kings seem to have a case ofBig Brother Worshiptowards him. And in every scene, he appears he fully show just why his status asThe Aceis fully earned. Always Someone Better:Played with, as he considers his older sister Mereleona stronger than him, but at the same time she considers him stronger than herself.Played straight with his younger brother Leopold, who sees Fuegoleon as more charismatic and talented. Played with, as he considers his older sister Mereleona stronger than him, but at the same time she considers him stronger than herself. Played straight with his younger brother Leopold, who sees Fuegoleon as more charismatic and talented.

characters.name: Mereoleona Vermillion
characters.description: The oldest child of the Vermillion family and sister of Fuegoleon and Leopold. She replaces Fuegoleon as captain of the Crimson Lion Kings after he is injured. Mereoleona has a short temper and hates to lose, but also a kinder, more caring side. She has little interest in politics and hates the stuffiness of the Clover Kingdom. A gifted hand-to-hand fighter, Mereoleona claims she has never been defeated on the battlefield. Uses a particularly brutal brand of Flame Magic capable of burning through other spells. Each of her own spells revolves around summoning fists of fire to pummel her opponents from every direction. Thanks to living in the wilderness for most of the year, she has a powerful Mana Skin and also uses Mana Zone to control the mana of her surroundings. The Ace: Mereoleona iscrazypowerful, renowned as completely undefeated, and is made the Captain of the elite Royal Knights unit, who also completely crushes one of the strongest members of the Third Eye. Action Girl: The strongest Magic Knight in the Clover Kingdom, a powerful hand-to-hand combatant, and user of a brutal form of Flame Magic to pummel enemies. Stated by Zora when Rhya says that she's wasting her beauty:"She's not a beauty. She's a beast." Aloof Big Sister: Disparages Fuegoleon for being comatose and letting his squad rank low as captain, and is harsh towards Leopold when he tries to defend their brother. Despite this, it's clear that she cares greatly for her younger brothers, and attacks the Eye of the Midnight Sun in revenge for Fuegoleon.

characters.name: Randall Luftair
characters.description: Blow You Away: He uses Air Magic, unleashing blasts of air that can disperse enemy attacks. Combination Attack: In the anime, he forms a sphere of his Air Magic with Leopold's Flame Magic covering it against golems in the Yultim Volcano. Full-Contact Magic: How he uses his Air Magic in contrast to other mages in the story. The elf that possesses him unleashes it mostly with palm blows. Kung-Fu Wizard: His fighting style is shown to be this when he's taken over by an elf, adopting a martial arts stance and unleashing air blasts from his movements. Meaningful Name:Not only does his last name include "air", but "luft" is German for air as well.Randall is an English name with the phonetic element "rand", meaning shield. His Air Magic is used to disperse spells.

characters.name: Leopold Vermillion
characters.description: A fiery and hot-blooded young man that follows his older brother to learn from him. He also considers Asta his new rival.Uses Flame Magic just like his older brother, forming blasts of fire. Animal Battle Aura: When fighting the giant spider in the Yultim Volcano in the anime, he manifests a leonine aura of fire. Animal Motifs: Lions, specifically lion cubs as he's much younger and less experienced than his older siblings. Anime Hair: Red colored, wild, and spiky. It becomes slightly more reasonable after the time skip. Area of Effect: His spellTrue Flame Magic: Crimson Eruption. He creates a giant spell array that unleashes a gigantic blast of fire, using it to burn everything within his magic circle to injure a hidden Sivoir.

characters.name: Ruben Chagar
characters.description: Dishing Out Dirt: He uses Sandstone Magic to form sand twisters and blocks of stone. Elemental Hair Colors: Long brown hair with Sandstone Magic. Rewarding Inactivity: He's not shown doing much in one of the final matches of the Royal Knights Selection Exam, but his team still wins. Samurai Ponytail: He has this hairstyle, and is fiercely loyal to his captain Fuegoleon. Sharing a Body: It turns out that he has the soul of an elf named Rossa.

characters.name: Forti Gliss
characters.description: A 4th Class Intermediate Magic Knight. Combination Attack: Curtis uses his Strong Bow to fire Forti's Burst Javelins at Team B's crystal, with Rick scoping them with his Crystal Scope. Elemental Hair Colors: He has orange hair and Flame Magic. Elemental Weapon: His spell Burst Javelin forms a javelin that he launches. Inconsistent Spelling: His name is spelled Forti Gliss by VIZ and the dub, but Forte Gris by the sub.

characters.name: Ben Benfunk
characters.description: A 4th Class Intermediate Magic Knight who uses Copper Magic. Carry a Big Stick: He creates a giant mace to slam onto an Eye of the Midnight Sun member when the Royal Knights raid the hideout. Elemental Eye Colors: Red eyes to go with the color of his Copper Magic. Extra-ore-dinary: He uses Copper Magic, able to form a giant mace. Repetitive Name: His name isBenBenfunk.

characters.name: Gareth
characters.description: A member of the Crimson Lion Kings. Curb-Stomp Battle: His team is easily defeated by Langris's Spatial Magic. Extra-ore-dinary: He uses Iron Magic to form a defensive wall and giant bullet. Iron Maiden: His defensive iron wall has the appearance of this.

characters.name: Rokken
characters.description: A member of the Crimson Lion Kings. Dishing Out Dirt: He uses Stone Magic, forming a huge boulder that he throws. Elemental Hair Colors: Brown hair and Stone Magic. Meaningful Name: His name sounds a lot like rock, and he uses Stone Magic. The Worf Effect: He gets defeated by a possessed Randall.

characters.name: Goht
characters.description: A former member of the Crimson Lion Kings. Animal Motifs: Goats. His name is a pun on goat and he uses his magic to form a ram of mana and goat horns. Canon Foreigner: He only appears in the anime. Fallen Hero: A former Magic Knight who became a bandit leader. Meaningful Name: His name is a pun for goat and his magic forms sheep out of mana and goat horns.

characters.name: Salamander
characters.description: The spirit of flame that serves Fana and later Fuegoleon. Ambiguous Gender: Unlike with the other two spirits shown so far, nothing about its gender has been revealed. Blue-and-Orange Morality: The only apparent criteria it uses to pick its masters is by judging if they are strong enough to be worthy to wield its power. As such, it picked two very different people as its owners such as Fana (a violent terrorist hellbent of reducing her enemies to ashes) and Fuegoleon (a proud and dignified Magic Knight that worries for the lives of the people of his country regardless of their social status). Elemental Embodiment: It's the flame spirit. Empathic Shapeshifter: Salamander seems to have its appearance change based on its user. With Fana, it is normally a small lizard but can grow into a monstrous humanoid dragon. When used by Fuegoleon, it's leaner and more serpentine.

characters.name: Wizard Kings in General
characters.description: All There in the Manual: A bonus volume, Volume 23.5, reveals Garandros, Funnybunny and Avalaché's background story,Freudian Excusesand deaths which were never mentioned in theSword of the Wizard Kingmovie itself. Appropriately, they're all framed as tragicAnti-Villains. The Archmage: Whoever holds this title is considered as the strongest mage of the Clover Kingdom and the military commander of all the Magic Knights in the kingdom with its captains answering to him or her in the chain of command. Asskicking Leads to Leadership: The only requirement to become Wizard King is throughmeritas Julius Novachrono explained to Asta and Yuno.Julius:People want just one thing from the Wizard King... Achievements that mark you as the strongest. Produce results. Devote yourselves to building a reputation... That's everything. No one who's unable to do that could ever stand at the top...! Big Good: As the Wizard King, the holder of the title must lead the Magic Knights against powerful threats to protect the Clover Kingdom. The latest two Wizard Kings, on the other hand,rebelled against the Kingdom somewhere down the line and made themselves formidable threats against the Kingdom they're supposed to protect in the first place. Combat, Magic, Trickery Trio: The three revived Wizard Kings from theSword of the Wizard Kingmovie fit this dynamic with their magical abilities and fighting styles: Princia is Combat, being an expertKung-Fu Wizardand having a Legion Magic that produces metallic soldiers; Edward is Magic, fighting purely from a distance by freezing his opponents or creating different ice structures; Jester is Trickery, applying his Barrier Magic in many creative ways while being an on-foot planner on a battlefield.

characters.name: 1st Wizard King — Lumiere Silvamillion Clover
characters.description: A prince of the Clover Kingdom five centuries ago chosen by a four-leaf clover who later became known as the First Wizard King. Lumiere was interested in developing magic tools to achieve equality. He was friends with Licht, but had to fight against him due to his transformation into a demon.Lumiere uses Light Magic, forming bursts and blades of light. The Ace: His magic and talent were noted to be amazing even among royalty, with his mana stated to be even more powerful than the elves and having the brilliance to invent many magical tools with the help of Secre. His feat of defeating the demon that threatened the Clover Kingdom established the very title of the Wizard King. All-Loving Hero: He's incredibly kind, wanting to help the commoners of his kingdom and working with Licht in hope that humans in the kingdom would peacefully coexist with the elves. Although his family didn't like his progressive ideals, this didn't bother him. The Archmage: Even among the royalty of the Clover Kingdom, his magic was far more powerful than anyone else. He had a four-leaf clover grimoire, bestowed on exceptional mages, and rare, powerful Light Magic. His defeat of the demon that attacked the kingdom established the very title of the Wizard King. An Arm and a Leg: His arm is cut off during the fight against Zagred. Secre reattaches it using her sealing magic.

characters.name: 11th Wizard King — Princia Funnybunny
characters.description: The 11th Wizard King and one of the antagonists ofBlack Clover: Sword of the Wizard King. A warrior whose power was renowned even amongst Wizard Kings and was feared for her strength. Princia uses Legion Magic to create and control chess-like soldiers. All There in the Manual: Bonus material indicates that she was a former member of the Blue Roses before ascending to Wizard King. Blood Knight: She mostly hides it under a stoic mask but she's thrilled to fight strong opponents. When she encounters someone as strong as Mereleona, she's visibly excited and happy to give it her all. Born in the Wrong Century: She muses that she and Mereoleona would have been great friends in her time instead of enemies. Chess Motifs: Her Legion Magic lets her create magical soldiers in the shape of chess pieces, and her Grimoire has a chessboard pattern on it.

characters.name: 16th Wizard King — Jester Garandros
characters.description: The 16th Wizard King and one of the antagonists ofBlack Clover: Sword of the Wizard King. He has a frivolous demeanor and tends to look down on others but has a cunning and tactical side. Jester uses Barrier Magic to form barriers and weapon constructs. Agent Peacock: Is significantly more flamboyant and jovial than the otherWizard Kings, but still proves capable of battlingYuno,Yami,FuegoleonandNozelon even terms for a significant amount of time (albeit the latter threewere running on fumes at that point).In the end, they didn't even beat him, Asta destroying the Imperial Sword cut off the power keeping him alive. Ambition Is Evil: During his time as 16th Wizard King, he planned to conquer the kingdoms of Heart, Spade and Diamond and assimilate them with Clover Kingdom which would unify the entire continent under one banner. Unfortunately, he never gets to fulfill his goal due to a trap made by corrupt royals. Barrier Warrior: He uses Barrier magic, although in combat he prefers to shape his barriers into weapons he wields in battle. Beware the Silly Ones: He may have a frivolous attitude like a clown but underneath it, he has a calculating and strategic side and proves why he was known as the 16th Wizard King.

characters.name: 20th Wizard King — Edward Avalaché
characters.description: The 20th Wizard King and one of the antagonists ofBlack Clover: Sword of the Wizard King. He was the priest of a church and was relied on and adored by the people, wanting to improve the lives of the weak. Edward uses Ice Wedge Magic to form constructs of jagged ice. Badass Preacher: He was a priest before becoming Wizard King, and it shows in his magic, forming a shield adorned with a cross, a gigantic church, and an angelic creature, all made of ice. Biblical Motifs: Is obviously a priest, and many of his spells relate to religion, taking shapes such as churches and angels. Blue Means Cold: Has blue clothing, mana, and a Grimoire and wields theincredibly powerful Ice Wedge Magic. The Call Knows Where You Live: He initially didn't want to become a Magic Knight and was perfectly content in being a mere pastor. Unfortunately, when the Diamond Kingdom destroyed his orphanage during a raid, he had to take up the job so he could gain enough strength to protect the weak.

characters.name: 27th Wizard King — Conrad Leto
characters.description: The 27th Wizard King who is the predecessor of Julius Novachrono and the main antagonist ofBlack Clover: Sword of the Wizard King. He suddenly rebelled against the Clover Kingdom and was sealed by Julius. Conrad uses Key Magic that open and close magical doors able to store magic within. Ability Mixing: Thanks to being able to release many different attributes of stolen magic from hisKey Magicdoors at once, he can even combine them to unleash powerful compound magic spells. Affably Evil: Mainly towardsAsta, who believes that they arequite similar in a way. As such, he always offers Asta to side with him, with promises of making him the next Wizard King. After Asta rejects his offer many times, Conrad decides to fight him, although he states he will regret killing Asta. All for Nothing: He sees his becoming Wizard King as this due to not being unable to change the kingdom's inequality and prejudice during his tenure, seeing the country as corrupt to its core and being a Wizard King as useless. Because of this he wants to use the power of the Imperial Sword to destroy the kingdom and choose which souls deserve to live in his new world. All of the Other Reindeer: Not unlike Asta, he was hated even as a child for his thief-like Key Magic. When he found the true potential of his magic as an adult people began tofear him for his power.

characters.name: # — L
characters.description: Ability Mixing: By combiningMana Zonewith hisTime Magic, Julius can accelerate the time of mana around him tosense the very near future and anticipate attacks. The Ace:Thestrongest mage in the kingdom as the current Wizard King with an extremely powerful magic, beloved by all the country's citizens for his strength and kind, affable nature, and a figure of wisdom with great knowledge and experience in different magics and the country's social dynamics. All-Loving Hero: His goal is to end the discrimination between the aristocrats and commoners and peasants of the Clover Kingdom. Julius himself is very courteous and kind, making him loved and respected by everyone in the kingdom. He even holds no grudge against Vangeance for keeping the secret that he has Licht's soul, attributing it to his kindness. The Archmage: As his title would imply, he's considered the strongest mage of the Clover Kingdom, and is the military commander of all the magic knights in the kingdom. No thanks to being a magic nerd, he's also very knowledgeable regarding many different types of magic. Asskicking Leads to Leadership: Says to Asta and Yuno that the only requirement to become Wizard King ismerit, right before opening a door to reveal a dozen other talented young sorcerers as part of the Distinguished Service Ceremony. He finally proveswhyonscreen when he wipes out an entire squad of mages who completely overpowered the heroes and Captain Fuegoleon in seconds without getting a scratch.

characters.name: Diamond Kingdom in General
characters.description: The Bad Kingdom: Diamond Kingdom is introduced to be this where it is a military-themed nation that raided neighboring lands for their resources to sustain themselves, and they're led by a terrible king who seeks to have immortality from the Witch Queen by any means necessary.And that Morris is the one who calls the shots while experimenting on many Diamond's children to bepowerful mages he modified to wield two mana attributes artificially. It eventually shifts toThe Good Kingdomafter Mars leadsThe Coupto overthrow the old king and force Morris to flee to Spade Kingdom. Black Cloak: The kingdom's Mage Warriors wear blue cloaks as part of their standard uniform that obscure their eyes. The Cavalry: Mars and cocome in to stop Morris and fight Lucius's evil plan at the end of the series, promising to defend the world. Child Soldiers: Mage Scholars perform human experiments on children with powerful magic to have them become Mage Warriors. They're seen implanting mage stones and performing surgeries on the children to give them new abilities. Mars, who has two magic attributes, and Ladros, who can absorb and release mana as lasers, are the direct result of these experiments. Cultural Posturing: Members of Diamond Kingdom like to flaunt their superiority over Clover Kingdom by attempting to invade their lands for their resources and defeat the Magic Knights they believe them to be weak.

characters.name: Diamond King
characters.description: Asshole Victim:Even though Morris is the true ruler the whole time, the king of Diamond Kingdom is still a horrid leader who ends up overthrown by Mars who leadsThe Coup. The Caligula: While unseen, he was known as a horrid tyrant who subjected his citizens to brutality and wanted to achieve immortality. The Ghost: He is the mentioned but yet to be seen ruler of the Diamond Kingdom. Immortality Immorality: The reason why he sent his country's forces to the Forest of Witches? Given that the Witch Queen had already lived for centuries while still preserving a healthy form, he hoped that his soldiers could force the secret of eternal youth out of her so that he could recover his own health and potentially attain immortality. No Name Given: His name is yet to be mentioned.

characters.name: Morris Libardirt
characters.description: A magic scholar who works for the Diamond Kingdom, running a series of experiments on children to boost the kingdom's power, and has been controlling the country's king. After being forced out by Mars, Morris works with the Dark Triad and becomes the devil host of the ultimate devil Lucifero.He possesses Modification Magic, letting him alter the structures of physical and magical targets. When boosted by devil power of Lucifero, gaining the demon's Gravity Magic, Morris's magic can affect even intangible concepts like knowledge and dreams. He later acquires Earth magic when converted into a Paladin. Actor Allusion: Not thefirst time his English voice actor playedaMad Scientistwilling to use a child in his inhumane experiments. Badass Transplant: Weaponized. He uses his magic to transplant Lolopechka's wisdom into himself, using this information to accelerate the Tree of Qliphoth's growth. Bad Powers, Bad People: The magic to extract others' powers and surgically implant them into others or himself fits with a villain like him who's willing to experiment on children and kill them when they're no longer useful. Be Careful What You Wish For: He wanted to see a transcendent form of a human being surpassing all expectations. Thanks to Mereleona, he got it.And it was the last thing he'd ever see.

characters.name: Mars
characters.description: A sorcerer who has been enhanced by magical experimentation on his body, and one of the Eight Shining Generals of the new generation. Entirely devoted to his mission, Mars is a juggernaut of a sorcerer, wielding both Mineral Magic and Flame Magic.His Mineral Magic manifests as weapons, waves of diamonds, and crystal golems. His Flame Magic allows him to drape himself in purifying fire to mend his wounds. Adaptational Dye-Job: He was initially portrayed with pink hair, blue eyes and green magic stones in an early manga cover before his color palette was set for good into grayish purple hair, pink eyes and aquamarine magic stones. Curiously enough he's depicted with the former color palette in the Jump Festa OVA, while the anime goes with the latter. Anime Hair: His hair is spiked up in all directions. Arc Villain: Of the Dungeon Exploration Arc, coming into conflict with the Black Bulls and Golden Dawn over retrieving the treasures in the dungeon. Bash Brothers: He becomes this with Asta after the they work together to save Fana, with the two acknowledging each other as friends and promising to help each other whenever needed.

characters.name: Lagus
characters.description: One of the Eight Shining Generals, and of the old generation. He attacks Kiten along with his comrades.He's a master of Lightning Magic. Animal Motifs: HisLightning Magiclets him ride astride a bird of prey. Curb-Stomp Battle: Yuno beats him in no time at all. This is justified as he's of the old generation of the generals. Curtains Match the Windows: He has light blue hair and eyes. Impaled with Extreme Prejudice: He gets pierced by Yuno's large wind trident.

characters.name: Brocks
characters.description: One of the Eight Shining Generals, and of the old generation. He never backs down before a challenge.He wields Red Clay Magic to encase himself within an armor of ochre and ram through every obstacle. Afro Asskicker: He has an afro and is one of the strongest warriors of the Diamond Kingdom. Animal Motifs: Boars, riding one made ofRed Clayand using it for offense, in addition to fitting his brute force approach to combat. Attack! Attack! Attack!: Instead of retreating, he decides to take on Vangeance himself. Blood Knight: He relishes the chance to attack the Clover Kingdom and take on its Magic Knights.

characters.name: Yagos
characters.description: One of the Eight Shining Generals, and of the old generation.He manipulates some extremely sticky Slime Magic that manifests as a giant snail, and saps its victims' life force. An Arm and a Leg: He loses his right arm to Langris'sSpatial Magic. Animal Motifs: HisSlime Magictakes the form of a snail, reflecting that despite his sadism he is ultimately a vulnerableSquishy Wizardbeneath a thin shell. Blob Monster: Can create these with his Slime Magic. Cold-Blooded Torture: His Slime Magic slowly weakens its victims.

characters.name: Ladros
characters.description: A mage who is one of the kingdom's Eight Shining Generals, and is of the new generation. Like Mars, Ladros comes from the Diamond Kingdom's laboratories.His unnatural power allows him to absorb and gulp down mana, before releasing it as a barrage of lasers. Adaptational Badass: In the manga, he's defeated in a single chapter by Asta's Black form despite wielding the power of Salamander. Thanks toAdaptation Expansion, he fares better in the anime, where he puts more of a fight and lasts the whole episode fighting Asta. Agent Peacock: Is quite flamboyant and loves to talk, but is a surprisingly crafty and ruthless combatant who is an expert at taking advantage of his unique abilities and tricking opponents into helping him power up. Beam Spam: HisSignature Move, "MIIIIIRIOOON LAISAAAAAAAA". Black Eyes of Crazy: Has black eyes along with red irises, but strangely enough, his pupils aren't visible. His eyes were completely normal when he was a child, with the implication his eyes turned black thanks to the experiments performed on him.

characters.name: Feremena
characters.description: The last of the New Generation roster among the Eight Shining Generals. She was Morris's former greatest success andthe host of the Spirit of Earth. Action Girl: As a Shining General, she is this as she is ready to confrontPaladinMorris in battle. Badass Cape: She wears the standard cloak of the Diamond Kingdom with her fellow Shining Generals, and she is ready for battle against Morris. Beauty Is Never Tarnished: She has some scars all over her body as a result of experiments byMorrisbut it does not subtract from her beauty. Boyish Short Hair: She has short hair when she shows up to fight Morris.

characters.name: Lotus Whomalt
characters.description: A sorcerer known as the "Lotus of the Abyss". He's a veteran of the Clover-Diamond War, having fought Yami on the front lines.He uses Smoke Magic to camouflage himself and sap his targets' strength, never confronting his opponents directly. Action Dad: He has three daughters, who are one of the reasons he's serving as a soldier for the Diamond Kingdom to protect his country. Affably Evil: He's laid back, polite and casual regardless of the situation, never resorting to insulting and belittling others barring some mild sarcasm. Anti-Villain: Antagonistic, but not evil at all if his words are to believed. The only reason why he's fighting the protagonists is that he's just doing his job as a soldier: trying to preserve the livelihood of his people by raiding the Clover Kingdom due to the Diamond Kingdom's dire straits. Heck, he even apologizes for all of the fights he's responsible for. An Arm and a Leg:Gets the lower part of his right arm cut off by Morris after betraying him.

characters.name: Fana
characters.description: One of the three Members of "Third Eye", the elite squad of the Eye of the Midnight Sun. Underneath her tranquillity is someone mentally unstable.Wields Flame Magic of cataclysmic proportions, and is always accompanied by the Flame Spirit, Salamander. She is also a skilled user of Recovery Magic. Animal Battle Aura:Her spell Salamander's Talon summons Salamander, covering its claw in fire to unleash burning slashes.She can manifest her Flame Magic as draconic beings similar to Salamander. Her spell Salamander's Talon summons Salamander, covering its claw in fire to unleash burning slashes. She can manifest her Flame Magic as draconic beings similar to Salamander. Avenging the Villain: In the Forest of Witches Arc, while part of her motivation to travel to the aforementioned forest is to take the magic stone in possession of the Witch Queen, her main goal is to avenge Vetto's death in the Underwater Temple at the hands of the Black Bulls.

characters.name: Spade Kingdom in General
characters.description: Ambiguous Situation: It is yet to be revealed how the two ancient demons were defeated and sealed away to be guarded by House of Grinberryall as shown with Licht, who transformed himself into a demon, just to deny Zagred from possessing his body, almost ended humanity if it weren't for Lumiere Silvamillion Cloverstopping him. Ancient Evil: Since long ago, the House of Grinberryall has been guarding two ancient demons who were once phenomenally strong young royals whose hatred for each other turned them into demons.The Dark Triad unleashes one on the Spade Kingdom Resistance which fights Mereoleona, while the other is sent to attack the Clover Kingdom, unable to be stopped by the Magic Knights, Julius, and Damnatio with Asta appearing to save the kingdom. The Bad Kingdom: After overthrowing the Grinberryall royal family, the Dark Triad turns Spade fromThe Good Kingdomto this where they subvert most of its military to serve them as Dark Disciples and oppress the people they were supposed to protect.With the defeat of the Dark Triad, Spade reverts back to its former status quo with Queen Ciel retaking the throne. Base on Wheels: The Spade Kingdom has giant mobile fortresses built to cross Strong Magic Regions, one of which is named Candelo, that runs off exhausting Low Stagers of their mana. The Coup: The Spade Kingdom underwent this in the past, with the peaceful House of Grinberryall overthrown and killed by the Dark Triad.

characters.name: Loyce Grinberryall
characters.description: Cosmic Motifs: The sun, matchinghis magicand being such a good rulerthat everyone under his reign had nothing but good things to say about him. Disappeared Dad: Was killed by Dante shortly not long after Yuno was born. The Good King: A kind and just king who loved his people. Male Sun, Female Moon: Was the king with Sun Magic and his wife and queen having Moon Magic, and their son Yuno having Star Magic. Posthumous Character: He was killed prior to the start of the series.

characters.name: Ciel Grinberryall
characters.description: Good Parents: Ciel is known as being a loving mother to Yuno. Cosmic Motifs: The moon, matchingher magicand being a light to the Spade Kingdom that manages to return after a long period. Male Sun, Female Moon: Was the queen with Moon Magic and her husband and king having Sun Magic, and their son Yuno having Star Magic. Meaningful Name: Her name "Ciel" means "sky" in French. Her son Yuno is a wind mage whose favorite thing is the sky and his true magic turns out to be star magic. Not Quite Dead:It’s revealed that Ciel is actually still alive and is with theLa Résistancefor protection.

characters.name: Ralph Niaflem
characters.description: Adaptational Early Appearance: Appears in Episode 156 of the anime, which shows him escaping the Spade Kingdom with the help of his comrades in the resistance to reach Yuno. Elemental Motifs: Flames, matchinghis magicand befitting someone who provided warmth and protection to Yuno in his troubled infanthood. Elemental Hair Colors: A flame mage with red hair. Legacy of Service: His family has served the House of Grinberryall for generations and he continues the tradition, referring to Yuno as master. Playing with Fire: He uses Flame Magic to show Yuno his father's memories, including Yuno's past before being left at Hage.

characters.name: Dante Zogratis
characters.description: One of the rulers of the Spade Kingdom and leader of the Dark Triad. He is the older brother of Vanica and Zenon, and devil host of the supreme devil Lucifero. Dante has a malicious, confident personality. He revels in harming others and follows the philosophy that malice is humanity's true nature.He uses two types of magic, the devil Lucifero's Gravity Magic and his innate Body Magic, whose regeneration has been enhanced by the power of his devil to self-heal from even the worst of injuries. Abhorrent Admirer:He becomes this to Vanessa, thinking she's a good fit for him because of her beauty, figure, and magic over fate. She's appalled to say the least.He becomes this to Grey as well when she shows herself to be another Arcane Stage. Like Vanessa, Grey looks horrified. He becomes this to Vanessa, thinking she's a good fit for him because of her beauty, figure, and magic over fate. She's appalled to say the least. He becomes this to Grey as well when she shows herself to be another Arcane Stage. Like Vanessa, Grey looks horrified. Actor Allusion: Patrick Seitzonce againvoices a charismatic, misogynistic sociopath who kills animals for fun and throws a hissy fit over losing a fistfight.

characters.name: Vanica Zogratis
characters.description: One of the rulers of the Spade Kingdom and a member of the Dark Triad. She is the sister of Dante and Zenon, and devil host of the supreme devil Megicula. Vanica cast a deadly curse on Acier Silva, the mother of Noelle, and Lolopechka, the Princess of the Heart Kingdom. She uses the power of her devil to follow her selfish desires and loves fighting strong enemies, feeling superiority in showing the power differential between herself and them.She uses two types of magic, the devil Megicula's Curse-Warding Magic to cast powerful curses and her innate Blood Magic, congealing blood into different forms. Achievements in Ignorance: A villainous one. Vanica's decision to capture Lolopechka instead of killing her, which was suggested by Megicula out of pragmatism, to motivate Noelle to become stronger for her to have a better fight becomes very useful for the Dark Triad when Morris transplants Lolopechka's wisdom into himself and use said knowledge to accelerate the Tree of Qliphoth's growth. Aloof Dark-Haired Girl:Zig-Zagged. She's an imposing villainess with black hair and can be psychotically expressive, but can easily switch to being callous and cruel whenever prompted, like when an enemy no longer amuses her or towards her Dark Disciples. Ambiguously Gay: Her interest in fighting a strong female opponent has these undertones, with Vanica telling Charlotte she likes her "soooooo much" and asking the captain to come with her. Ax-Crazy: Ax-Crazy enough to order her minions to slaughter innocent civilians just to rile up her opponents for Vanica to have a fun battle. She becomes more psychotic when fighting and using more of her devil's power, grinning maniacally and treating the battle against Noelle like a game of tag.

characters.name: Zenon Zogratis
characters.description: One of the rulers of the Spade Kingdom and a member of the Dark Triad. He is the younger brother of Dante and Vanica, and devil host of the supreme devil Beelzebub. Rational and ruthless, Zenon is much more powerful than the Magic Knight Captains and has enough power to easily overwhelm the army of the Diamond Kingdom alone.He uses two types of magic, the devil Beelzebub's Spatial Magic to create portals and control spaces and his innate Bone Magic, sprouting countless sharpened bones from his body to skewer enemies. Achilles' Heel: After becoming a devil, his is his heart, regenerating fast from any other body part hit and Yuno trying to aim for it with his Star Magic. Yuno ends up slicing through it with his Saint Spirit of Zephyr. Alliterative Name:ZenonZogratis. All of the Other Reindeer: Flashbacks show that, as a child, he was bullied by other kids for his creepy bone magic with Allen saving him, beginning their friendship and rivalry. Always Someone Better: To even Langris, who's surprised that he can even cast his huge Spatial Mana Domination without even moving. Zenon himself even tells Langris that if he didn't exist, he'd be the ultimate spatial mage.

characters.name: Gaderois Godroc
characters.description: Alliterative Name:GaderoisGodroc. Ax-Crazy: He's really into slaughtering the members of Golden Dawn. Blood Knight: He enjoys fighting and killing, and is excited to fight Yuno after he learns that he's been chosen by Sylph. The Brute: A large, brutal fighter who uses stone gauntlets with an enjoyment for killing the Golden Dawn members. Delinquent Hair: He has a mohawk, and is a bloodthirsty brute.

characters.name: Foyal Migusteau
characters.description: One of Zenon's Dark Disciples. He uses Mist Magic to form illusions and water bullets. Blank White Eyes: His eyes are completely white and round to contribute to his ghostly look. Creepy Shadowed Undereyes: He has dark circles around his white eyes to add to his disheveled, creepy appearance. Elemental Hair Colors: Long, shaggy light blue hair and uses Mist Magic. Giant Hands of Doom: His spell Sealing Spectral Hands forms large clawed hands to bind a target.

characters.name: Svenkin Gatard
characters.description: One of Vanica's Dark Disciples. He uses Skin Magic to soften and harden his skin. Adaptive Ability: His Skin Magic lets him be as tough or soft as he wants, changing its properties based on enemies' attributes to nullify their magic. Agent Peacock: Is a flamboyant and soft spoken individual, yet wields formidable magic and is one of the most physically imposing of Vanica's disciples. Anatomy Arsenal: He can harden his skin into cannons that fire mana blasts. Beard of Evil: Has a prominent beard and is introduced happily massacring citizens of the Heart Kingdom to impress Vanica.

characters.name: Sivoir Snyle
characters.description: One of Vanica's Dark Disciples. He uses Eye Magic, manifesting eyeballs to increase his vision and fire magic shells from far away. Alliterative Name:SivoirSnyle. Aura Vision: His eyeballs can see magic, stamina, and predict an enemy's next move using muscle movements. Body Motifs: Eyes, befitting someone whofights opponents at a distance. Cold Sniper: Arrogant about having never been wounded in battle, and uses his Eye Magic to snipe from afar using magic spells.

characters.name: Halbet Chevour
characters.description: Body Motifs: Hair, reflecting her shallow, haughty, and vain personality. Expressive Hair: Her regrown hair angrily flows upward to match her rage at Charmy for destroying her hair after being resurrected. Evil Counterpart: To Charmy, who she fights in the Heart Kingdom. Charmy, by then, has become fat, with Halbet being a thin woman who mocks her for being an unsightly fatty. Halbet thinks consuming food is idiotic for making you fat and ugly. Charmy, stating this after beating her up, believes true beauty comes from proper nutrition and meals. The Fighting Narcissist: While fighting Charmy, she's constantly talking about how beautiful she is. After being revived by Vanica's curse, she's enraged at Charmy for having ruined her hair. Laser-Guided Karma: While she derides Charmyfor being fat, she ends upbeing even bigger than Charmy when Vanica detonates the devil power she gave her.

characters.name: Hischer Ongg
characters.description: Eyes Always Shut: He has his eyes closed throughout his brief appearances. Hidden Depths: According to his Character Profile, he has recently taken up cooking. We Hardly Knew Ye: Compared to the rest of the Dark Disciples who are Stage 0 like him and defeated one of the Spirit Guardians, he has the least screentime with the fight between Gaja and Hischer happened offscreen, with the former being victorious prior to Vanica resurrecting the latter andthen blowing him upwithout his name revealed until his Character Profile in Volume 26. The Worf Effect: He's a Stage Zero Dark Disciple who easily defeats Sarado, the Spirit Guardian of Earth. Gaja defeats him easily, off-page to boot.

characters.name: Robero Ringert
characters.description: One of Vanica's Dark Disciples. He uses his Tongue Magic to elongate his tongue. Alliterative Name:RoberoRingert. Animal Motifs: What with his long tongue that he can control and portly body, Mimosa calls him a frog. Body Motifs: Tongues, with his magic enlarging his own and being so disgusting that evenVanicafinds him repulsive. The Brute: Is one of the larger members of Vanica's Disciples, and certainly the dimmest.

characters.name: Allen Fiarain
characters.description: A former member of the Mage Defense Force and Zenon's former rival. Childhood Friends: With Zenon, who he had saved from bullies as a child and formed a rivalry and friendship with to become the commander in chief of the Mage Defense Force that day. Flashbacks show that they trained and joined the force together. Sadly, their friendship ended when Zenon killed him to kill a devil that would have destroyed Spade. Energetic and Soft-Spoken Duo: Like Asta and Yuno, Allen was the Energetic to Zenon's Soft-Spoken as best friends and rivals:Allen:I'm not losing this time, Zenon!Zenon:There's no winning or losing on missions, Allen.Allen:Man, you're always so serious... Flaming Sword: Was seen wreathing his sword in flames as he charged against the devil in the dungeon. Four Is Death: Joined Division Four of the Mage Defense Force with Zenon. Naturally, he was killed by his rival to defeat the devil that they were fighting against.

characters.name: Ancient Demons
characters.description: Attack of the 50-Foot Whatever: They're gigantic, ancient demons that tower over the landscape. Demon of Human Origin: They were once royals of the Spade Kingdom and close friends until their affection for each other turned into hatred, turning them into demons. They were sealed away by the Royal Family until the Dark Triad released them to distract the Clover Kingdom in their war. Half the Man He Used to Be: One of them is diagonally bisected by Asta's giant Black Divider while he's in Devil Union. Unskilled, but Strong: Possess power and durability on par with theirgiganticsize, the one attacking the Clover Kingdomshrugging offan attack from nearly all the present Magic Knight, and it's own attack being enough to wipe the capital off the map. Said size also means the are unable to evade or block opponents whocanhurt them as was the case with Mereleona and aDevil UnionAsta, both being dispatched in short order. Was Once a Man: They were once young human royals of the Spade Kingdom until their hatred for each other turned them into demons.

characters.name: Heart Kingdom in General
characters.description: Beware the Nice Ones: Heart Kingdom may be rich in resources and is friendly with outsiders, so long they don't cause trouble, but they have the All-Knowing Priestess and the Spirit Guardians who are very powerful that makes eventhe most arrogant nobility of Clover Kingdomtread lightly with them than risk antagonizing their neighbor without suffering the consequences. The Cavalry: The Spirit Guardians and the rest of the forces who were training in Elysia join up with the Magic Knights and Resistance in theSpade Kingdom to help them fight against the devils released from the underworld and the Dark Triad. Crippling Overspecialization: The Heart Kingdom is heavily dependent on Princess Lolopechka and the Spirit Guardians protecting them from any threat with no militia or rank and file mages of their own. This bites them when Vanica Zogratis and her Dark Disciples attack Heart Kingdom where they took down most of the Spirit Guardians andLolopechka is taken hostage by Vanica who then set her followers to explode all over Heart Kingdom if it weren't for the efforts of Magic Knights aiding their allies. The Good Kingdom: Compared to Clover Kingdom,The Good Kingdomthat was plagued by various problems, the Heart Kingdom is this where it is ruled by the All-Knowing Priestess who literally watches over her people with her Water Magic and ensure their safety and prosperity. Informed Attribute: The Spirit Guardians are said to be the strongest mages of Heart Kingdom capable of commanding real elements, but four of these were easily crushed by Dark Disciples. Even way before then, one of them even got their magic eaten by Charmy and this was before the timeskip. The last one, Gaja averts this and is pretty much as strong as his rank suggests. Later on,the Spirit Guardians actually get to display their full power when aiding the Spade Kingdom'sLa Résistanceagainst the unleashed devils.

characters.name: Lolopechka
characters.description: The Princess of the Heart Kingdom, a mage chosen by the Water Spirit Undine. She is blessed with the magical talent and wisdom of the past princesses, and has the magical power to cover the whole country in her Mana Zone. Lolopechka loves her country and its people and has a strong desire to protect them. She was cursed to die by the devil Megicula, leading her to ally with the Clover Kingdom against the Spade Kingdom. All Your Powers Combined: Her magic and grimoire have the combined power of the previous queens of the Heart Kingdom. The Archmage: The strongest mage of the Heart Kingdom, with incredible magic power rivaling a Magic Knight squad, and a master of itsMana Methodwhich she teaches Noelle and Nero over the six month time skip. As a princess of the Heart Kingdom, she also has the power of the water spirit Undine and magical knowledge of all the previous generations of princesses. Barefoot Loon: Downplayed. She goes around barefoot and is not a loon so much as she isveryclumsy and absent-minded. Barefoot Sage: Walks barefoot and is the queen of the nature-attuned Heart Kingdom with the combined wisdom of the previous country's princesses, making her known as the kingdom's "All-Knowing Priestess".

characters.name: Undine
characters.description: The Water Spirit. Undine takes the form of a beautiful woman and has a contract with the Princess of the Heart Kingdom Lolopechka, whom she dotes on. She desires to defeat the devil Megicula to break the curse on Lolopechka. Elemental Embodiment: She's the water spirit. Elemental Hair Composition: Her long light blue hair is made of water. Fusion Dance:After forming a contract with Noelle following Lolopechka's kidnapping, she becomes able to fuse with Noelle to enter her Spirit Dive: Saint Valkyrie Armor. Guardian Entity: Of the Heart Kingdom, having hit it off with the first Heart Kingdom queen and protecting the Heart Kingdom with its subsequent queens ever since.

characters.name: Gaja
characters.description: A Spirit Guardian of the Heart Kingdom who's very loyal to Lolopechka. Gaja uses Lightning Magic, discharging powerful lightning bolts. The Ace: He's the strongest of the Spirit Guardians and was able to fightJuliuson even ground at one point. All Love Is Unrequited: He has romantic feelings for Lolopechka, who's unaware of them and states that she'd never date Gaja. Apologetic Attacker:Asks a controlled devil Lolopechka to forgive him before using hisPulsarantato stop her from moving for a few seconds, using that time to go and attack Megicula. Better to Die than Be Killed:Rather than die from the wound inflicted on him by a controlled devil Lolopechka and let her become a killer, he converts his life into his Ultimate Magic to destroy Megicula. However, he ends up getting saved by Rill's magic and later Mimosa.

characters.name: Potrof
characters.description: A Spirit Guardian of the Heart Kingdom. Green Thumb: He uses Plant Magic, letting him grow large vines. Mentor Archetype: He becomes this to Charmy and Rill during the six month time skip, teaching them how to use magic arrays with natural mana. My God, What Have I Done?:This isPlayed for Laughs. He states that he created a monster from training Charmy after he sees her use her giant sheep to gather all the food in a forest.He says this again after Charmy uses her Food Magic with an array to brutally defeat Halbet. This isPlayed for Laughs. He states that he created a monster from training Charmy after he sees her use her giant sheep to gather all the food in a forest.

characters.name: Floga
characters.description: A Spirit Guardian of the Heart Kingdom. Fire Is Red: The colour of his grimoire andFlame magic, as well as his cloack. Mentor Archetype: He is assigned to train Leopold during the six month time skip and helps him to both overcome his insecurities and grows stronger, believing that Leopold holds potential greater than his own. Playing with Fire: His magic. He masters the Heart Kingdom's special technique, mana method, and uses it to create powerful fire spells.

characters.name: Smurik
characters.description: Blow You Away: On a level befitting the Spirit Guardian of Wind. Mentor Archetype: Acts as one to Finral during his training, refining his abilities as aSupport Party Member. Wind Is Green: HisWind magicis green in colour.

characters.name: Sarado
characters.description: Always Someone Better: By Charlotte's account, herEarth magicis stronger and faster than her subordinate Sol's. Bare Midriffs Are Feminine: Is aAmazonian Beautywith her sixpack showing. Amazonian Beauty: Is a large and muscular woman who is quite nice looking. Dishing Out Dirt: Is a Spirit Guardian of the Heart Kingdom, possessing the most powerfulEarth magic in the kingdom. Yellow Earth, Green Earth: Her mana is a yellow colour when using herEarth magic.

characters.name: Ryudo Ryuya
characters.description: The current Shogun of the Land of the Sun and Yami's childhood friend. Asta meets him after seemingly being "killed" by Lucius and Sister Lily. His Tengentsu lets his right eye see everything happening during any moment. Alliterative Name:RyudoRyuya. Big Good: With Julius revealed to be aSplit Personalityof Lucius and subsumed by him when hisEvil Planfinally goes into motion, Ryuya steps in as the big guiding influence for the heroes to counter-attack his machinations, using hisMagical Eyeto step in at the right moment to discreetly save Asta without Lucius' knowledge and train him to become strong enough to counter Lucius' overwhelming might. Childhood Friends: He was one to Yami. They haven't seen each other since Yami was thirteen years old, however. Citywide Evacuation: Orders one of these when three Paladins attack the Land of the Sun under Lucius's orders. It's for a good reason considering anyone who gets killed by Lucius's Paladins can and will be resurrected and used against the country, meaning that if he didn't order an evacuation, the Paladins will inevitably cause collateral damage and turn everyone they killed against the Land of the Sun.

characters.name: Mikuriya Fumito
characters.description: A Recovery Yojutsu genius and friend of Ryuya. Heal It with Water: A recovery yojutsu genius who heals using large goldfish made of water. Nice Guy: He's very kind, happily healing and cooking for others. Supreme Chef: Ryuya calls him a genius in cooking on top of healing, with Asta complimenting his food. He even cooks thefive-headed dragon after it's slayed.

characters.name: Yami Ichika
characters.description: Yami Sukehiro's younger sister and a member of the Ryuzen Seven. She's a serious young woman who hates her brother for killing their clan, and is very loyal to Ryuya for being her benefactor. Ichika uses Dark Yojutsu in combination with sword fighting and martial arts. Abusive Parents: Heralcoholic fatherresented her because her mother died shortly after giving birth to her, a girl who couldn't fight, and was about to hit her with a wooden sword until Yami stopped him with his. He's her manifestation of a memory of fear by Yrul's Bogeyman due to treating her cruelly as a child, and gave her a drug that caused her inner yoryoku to go berserk and drove her into slaying her own clan. The massacre makes him praise her for her power before likelygetting killed right after. Action Girl: Oh yes. She ragdolls Asta while he's in hisBlack formduring their sparring match using her martial arts and swordsmanship empowered by her ki. Ironically, heralcoholic fatherhatedher for not being a fighter when she was younger, forcing Yami to constantly protect her from his beatings. Aloof Ally: Ichika complies with Ryu's intention to have Asta train to defeat Lucius, demonstrating Zetten and telling Asta to try to do it himself while still making her dislike of him clear, even when hegenuinely thanks her for the opportunity to become stronger. Aloof Dark-Haired Girl: Long black hair in a braid and a cold, dismissive attitude especially towards Asta.

characters.name: Hanegatsuji Jozo
characters.description: A member of the Ryuzen Seven. He is a serious man in a black full-body suit and ahannyamask who can slice enemies with blades of wind. Elemental Personalities: Averted. He has Wind Yojutsu but instead of being carefree and flighty he's very serious and dour. Ninja: One who's much more serious about being one thanKomari, telling her to practice stealth. He even uses hand signs when casting his yojutsu. Only Sane Man: He's much more stern and serious than the other members of the Ryuzen Seven likeKomariandDaizaemon. Rage Helm: He wears ahannyamask, used in Japanese Noh theater to represent a demon, with an X-shaped scar on its forehead.

characters.name: O'oka Daizaemon
characters.description: A member of the Ryuzen Seven. He's a large-bodied monk who summons large Buddha statues made by Earth Yojutsu to fight. Big Fun: He has a big, wide build and is quite boisterous with his laughing and shouting. The Big Guy: Is by far the biggest of the Ryuzen Seven, and wieldsEarth Yojustsuthat specializes in straightforward, power focused attacks. Most obvious from hisGiant King of Wisdom. Big Ol' Eyebrows: Has thick eyebrows to go with his bald monk look. Dirty Old Monk:Played for Laughs. He has a monk-like appearance with his shaved head and prayer beads, but is a littletooexcited about how Komari's outfit leaves little to the imagination.

characters.name: Imari Komari
characters.description: A member of the Ryuzen Seven. She's a gaudyGyaru Girlwho is a ninja with a flashy outfit and an energetic personality. Dance Battler: Her Diamond Yasha Princess ☆ Fivefold Dance after all, moving with leaps and spins to cut up one of the five-headed dragon's heads with lightning kunai. Elemental Personalities: She has Lightning Yojutsu and is very lively and energetic. Elemental Weapon: She can form kunai out of lightning. Genki Girl: She's very energetic, wanting to liven up the Land of the Sun.

characters.name: Kezokaku Ginnojomorifuyu
characters.description: A member of the Ryuzen Seven. While seemingly a timid,Nervous Wreckof a girl, she turns into anAx-CrazyBlood Knightin combat. Absurd Phobia: She's terrified of frogs, shown when Yrul's Bogeyman took the form of a frog and that instantly puts her out of action. Asian Fox Spirit: Her spell Silver Fox in Blood-Dyed Robes gives her kitsune tails and ears and the strength to slice through one of the five-headed dragon's heads from inside its mouth. Blood Knight: What she turns into when she draws her sword, becoming eager about shedding blood. Blood-Splattered Warrior: What she becomes after cutting through the five-headed dragon's skull from inside its mouth, while using her spell namedSilver FoxinBlood-Dyed Robesat that.

characters.name: Mushogatake Yosuga
characters.description: The strongest member of the Ryuzen Seven and a master swordsman. He and Fujio volunteer to train Asta when Ichika and the others were deployed to deal with some invading Paladins. Absurdly Sharp Blade: States that his belief that he can cut anything is what makes himself strong, and he shows it by slicing through a walkway of stone steps and torii when training Asta. The Ace: He's said to be the strongest of the Ryuzen Seven, and proves it by easily overpowering Heath Grice in a one-one-one battle. Amazon Chaser: Asks Asta to introduce him to strong women from his country preferably one withflame yojutsu, with Asta immediately thinking ofMereoleona.The final chapter reveals Mereoleona's being courted in the Land of the Sun with a shot showing her and Yosuga fighting. Animal Motifs: Tigers. he was theTiger to Ryuya's Dragonwhen they were younger as rivals and heirs of nearby regions,the tiger is fitting for someone who is physically strong and confident in his strength.

characters.name: Tenmanyashiki Fujio
characters.description: A member of the Ryuzen Seven. His music can vitalize people and make them tougher. All Asians Wear Conical Straw Hats: A mage from theLand of the Sunwho wears a straw hat. Bakeneko and Nekomata: The cat on his shoulder is a nekomata with two tails. Magic Music: He has sound yojutsu. Playing his biwa reduces damage taken and restores stamina as well as communicate orders through long distances. Shoulder Teammate: A cat wearing a scarf sits on his shoulder.

characters.name: Rhya
characters.description: One of the three Members of "Third Eye", the elite squad of the Eye of the Midnight Sun. He seems frivolous but is Licht's trusted right-hand man.He uses Copy Magic to copy people's appearance and magic. Once he has copied a spell, it is forever stored in his Grimoire, granting him an abnormally large repertoire. Adaptational Badass: Downplayed. The anime goes into more detail with his fight against Mereoleona, showing Rhya using more spells of different attributes he is not seen using in the manga such as lightning, ice, gel, and earth, but still easily gets defeated by Mereoleona. Affably Evil: Rhya himself is very laidback and easygoing, complimenting Charlotte and Mereoleona on their beauty shortly before fighting them, and dislikes having to put in effort into follows this duties. That said, hestillis a member of the Third Eye with the power and hatred of humans that entails. All There in the Manual:The Volume 21 Assorted Questions Brigade states that he had impersonated Vangeance, whose arm had been injured by Julius when he attacked Patry, at the captains' meeting.The Volume 25 Assorted Questions Brigade reveals that the human host of his body was a suicidal, fallen noble. The Volume 21 Assorted Questions Brigade states that he had impersonated Vangeance, whose arm had been injured by Julius when he attacked Patry, at the captains' meeting.

characters.name: Vetto
characters.description: One of the three Members of "Third Eye", the elite squad of the Eye of the Midnight Sun. A relentless fighter crushing and crippling every opponent he meets.A user of Beast Magic, Vetto can copy the attributes of various animals, and manifest these beasts as a translucent aura around himself. When pushed to his limits, Vetto can access Mythical Beast Magic, which breaks common rules of magic and copies unknown animals. Animal Battle Aura: His Beast Magic projects mana in the shape of a chosen animal around him, giving him the attributes of said creature. Animal Motifs: While he uses many different animals with his Beast Magic, his most prominent seems to be Bear Claw, befitting aphysical powerhousewithsharp teeththat aims to drive his opponents to despair. Arc Villain: Of the Underwater Temple Arc, with him leading members of the Eye of the Midnight Sun to find a magic stone which causes him to face off against the Black Bulls. An Arm and a Leg: Loses his right arm during battle, which causes him to remember one moment of his past with Licht and open his third eye, and allows him to use Mythical Beast Magic to regenerate his arm.

characters.name: Heath Grice
characters.description: A mage sent to Saussy Village in order to find a certain magic stone. Heath keeps a very tight schedule and does not forgive a single second of difference. He detests people with low mana and is extremely loyal to Licht.He uses powerful Ice Magic, complimented by him leading a team of Mist Magic and Water Magic users. Arc Villain: Of the Magic Knights Entrance Exam Arc, trying to steal a magic stone from the village for the Eye of the Midnight Sun and attempting to kill all the villagers. Back from the Dead:334 chapters later,he mysteriously came back to life as one of Lucius's Paladins who made their way to the Land of the Sun alongside Yrul and Sister Lily. Barrier Warrior: His spell Crystal Shield forms snowflake barriers strong enough to withstand Magna's Flame Magic. Blue Means Cold: He has grey hair with a blue tint and wears a light blue shirt. He uses Ice Magic.

characters.name: Rades Spirito
characters.description: A former member of the Purple Orcas, he holds a grudge for being fired from the Magic Knights due to wielding a taboo magic. He is overconfident in his strength.Rades's Wraith Magic lets him reanimate dead individuals, putting them under his complete control. If they were mages, the zombies can use their own magic. Ability Mixing: He eventually learns how to create zombies stitched together from multiple dead bodies. Due to how his Wraith Magic works, this type of zombie has affinities for every magic type of its constituent bodies, and thus they're able to cast multiple-element spells that would normally be very difficult or impossible for a normal person to perform. Arc Villain: Of the Royal Capital Assault Arc, using his many corpses to attack the capital and luring Fuegoleon into a trap for the Eye of the Midnight Sun to steal his magic stone. The Atoner:Averted. Asta tries to force him to be this when he tries to team up with the Black Bulls to go to the Royal Capital and defeat Licht, telling him to do so to atone and not for revenge. He still refuses to change his motivation.Sort of. Valtos decides to atone for his sins after the battle with the elves and Rades follows him. While handcuffed, he complains about cleaning up the kingdom and then gets threatened byJack. Averted. Asta tries to force him to be this when he tries to team up with the Black Bulls to go to the Royal Capital and defeat Licht, telling him to do so to atone and not for revenge. He still refuses to change his motivation.

characters.name: Catherine
characters.description: A vain witch, obsessed with her own beauty and youth. She has a short temper and won't tolerate any negative comments about her appearance.Casts Ash Curse Magic spells that steals others' youth and inflicts random ailments. Ashes to Ashes: She uses cursed ash to drain mana from enemies to maintain her youth or deteriorate their five senses. Bad Powers, Bad People: The fact that she uses cursed ash to drain others' life energy and steal their senses go with her being a villainous witch. Berserk Button: Shehatesnegative remarks about her appearance, quickly going from fawning overYunoto trying tomurderhim when he makes one. Curb-Stomp Battle: Granted, she had just taken Yuno's attack, but she gets pummeled into the ground by Charmy's giant ram when she thinks that she's trying to steal her food.

characters.name: Valtos
characters.description: A calm, tactical mage who is extremely devoted to his master Licht.He uses Spatial Magic for teleportation. Can open up portals from a distance and fire mana bullets to harass his victims, or teleport them against their will. The Atoner: He decides to atone for his sins after the battle with the elves. He's seen cleaning up the kingdom while handcuffed. Back from the Dead: Rades's Wraith Magic revives him after he was sacrificed. The Bad Guy Wins: Even though the Black Bulls beat Rades' creation at their hideout, No. 0 Michael Caesar, Valtos still gets the magic stone left there anyway. Boxed Crook: After being imprisoned for his crimes against the Clover Kingdom, he becomes part of the assault force that attacks the Spade Kingdom.

characters.name: Sally
characters.description: A magical scientist who loves research and experimentation, keeping a ton of magical items and desperate to dissect and experiment on interesting individuals. She takes an interest in Asta due to his unique physiology.Her Gel Magic creates titanic blob-like salamander, which Sally often modifies by injecting them with magical products. Animal Motifs:Salamanders. She can form giant ones with her Gel Magic, and salamanders are symbolic of rebirth and passion. Sally is a scientist passionate about learning unique magics, and comes back to life thanks to Rades' magic.Scorpions, using a scorpion magic tool to boost her power. Salamanders. She can form giant ones with her Gel Magic, and salamanders are symbolic of rebirth and passion. Sally is a scientist passionate about learning unique magics, and comes back to life thanks to Rades' magic. Scorpions, using a scorpion magic tool to boost her power. The Atoner: After being revived by Rades, Sally gives the Black Bulls ideas in defeating Reve. She's later seen cleaning up the kingdom for "volunteer work" while handcuffed after the battle with the elves.

characters.name: George
characters.description: An underling whom Julius manages to retain while Licht arrives to get his men back. Blow You Away: Uses Wind Magic. Human Sacrifice: In Chapter 170, he and Catherine are shown to have been sacrificed. Undying Loyalty: Even if there were no protection magic cast on him, he would still not say anything to betray his master, claiming that the master had never abandoned him and the other members.

characters.name: Asta and Yuno
characters.description: Dark Is Not Evil: HisAnti-Magicgrimoire casts dark energy that gives him a demonic appearance in his Black form, and he wears a black bandana and black upper robe. Plus, his powerliterallycomes from a devil. Despite this,he's a noble guy who'll help anyone in need.Exemplified when hegains aBlack Knightlook upon achievingDevil Unionwith Liebe, yet he's without a doubt the most morally good devil host in the whole series out to save the world from devils. Heck, his devil partner turns out to be a pretty good guy too. David Versus Goliath:Asta is very short, standing at 155 cm (5'1"), and fights against the tall and beastly Vetto, whose brute strength has to be sapped by Asta's anti-magic sword before he defeats him with Finral and Vanessa's help.He faces off against the tall, imposing Dante. Even moreso when Dante uses his Body Magic to turn gigantic and muscular when Asta fights him alongside Yami. Asta is very short, standing at 155 cm (5'1"), and fights against the tall and beastly Vetto, whose brute strength has to be sapped by Asta's anti-magic sword before he defeats him with Finral and Vanessa's help. He faces off against the tall, imposing Dante. Even moreso when Dante uses his Body Magic to turn gigantic and muscular when Asta fights him alongside Yami. Deal with the Devil:To the gain the power needed tohelp Yami defeat Dante, Asta asks the Anti-Magic Devil to lend him his true power. He agrees to a "devil's bargain", taking control of Asta's right arm as the price.Soon after, he faces the Devil, named Liebe, to set up a more permanent deal— which in this case meansbefriendingthe devil and working alongside him as equal partners. I Can't Sense Their Presence: Since he has no magic, he cannot be detected by sensing magic. Hair-Contrast Duo: The loud, excitable Asta has spiky ash blond hair while the quiet, composed Yuno, his best friend and rival, has messy black hair. Ham and Deadpan Duo: Is the ham to his friend Yuno'sdeadpan. Handicapped Badass: Temporarily

characters.name: Julius Novachrono
characters.description: Master-Apprentice Chain: Was Yami's captain, taking him into the Gray Deer and teaching him the country's language and social customs, with Yami in turn becoming the captain ofAsta. He was also Vangeance's captain, who later went on to become the captain ofYuno. As Julius dies from his wound by Patry, he finds solace in knowing that his ideals of a country free of discrimination and hatred will live on in the next era of magic knights, with Asta reiterating that same dream in the chapter. Master of All: The Guidebook gives him a 5/5 in Magic Amount, Magic Control, Magic Sensing, and Cleverness. The only category he doesn't have a 5/5 in is Physical Strength which is 4/5, butwhen you're as strong of a mage as he is you don't need it. Meaningful Name:His first name isJuliusand, like his namesake, is a military leader. Gaius Julius Caesar's, who was dictator of Rome, cognomen (Caesar) also was synonymous with "emperor", and Juliusisthe Wizard King after all. Another similarity with the famous statesman, he's betrayed by a close subordinate which leads to him getting stabbed.His last name is Novachrono, nova and chrono being Latin for "new" and "time" respectively, and he uses Time Magic and gets de-aged after using his magic to save himself. Achilles' Heel: His foresight is such a powerful ability because he can act on what he sees both in combat and for longterm plans. However, he cannot perceive Asta within his predictions, which makes him a loose-end and is why he's Lucius's
